items.description: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure for up to 6 players. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen wagon, and haul it to Raccoon Paradise. Live your best raccoon life.
items.description_ja: 最大6人で遊べる物理演算ベースの協力アドベンチャーで、アライグマの仲間たちとチームプレイ。ゴミをあさって、盗んだワゴンをいっぱいにし、アライグマの天国へと運ぼう。最高のアライグマライフをお楽しみあれ！
items.title: Trash Day

items.description: Play cards with your friends or meet new opponents at a local bar where every match is a brand-new challenge! Test your strategy across 3 different game modes, each with their own unique rules and systems! Victory is never guaranteed, and there's always one card that can flip everything.
items.description_ja: 『Capote（カポテ）』は、ブラジルの伝統的なバーゲームに着想を得たマルチプレイカードゲームです。運、ブラフ、そして戦略が賑やかなバーの雰囲気でぶつかり合う。勝利は決して保証されず——たった1枚のカードが試合をひっくり返します。あなたは賭けを成功させられるのか、それとも大失敗するのか？
items.title: Capote

items.description: A handcrafted two player adventure set in low gravity. Solve intricate asymmetric puzzles and escape Moontella’s extremely profitable slime empire through chaos, laughter, and unforgettable true co-op moments with your partner.
items.description_ja:
低重力の世界を舞台にした、手作り感あふれる2人協力アドベンチャー。
非対称の複雑なパズルを解き明かし、混沌と笑い、そして忘れられない真の協力プレイの瞬間を通じて、パートナーと共にムーンテラ社の超高収益スライム帝国から脱出せよ。
items.title: Together: Moon Escape

items.description: Survive the treacherous sea in this quirky multiplayer shooter game! Play solo or team up and fight off Cthulhu's minions. Master a unique recoil-based mechanic to blast enemies and chart your course. Mix and match upgrades to craft the perfect sea-surviving strategy!
items.description_ja: 危険が潜む死の海で、謎の怪異を迎え撃つのは...まさかのマメ粒？！仲間と一緒に立ち向かえ——1〜4人のローカル＆オンライン協力プレイ対応。
items.title: Bang Bang Barrage

items.description: Time to clock in at DE NILE SHIPPING, the world’s “most efficient” warehouse! Work together in online co-op with up to 4 players to fulfill orders of increasingly chaotic, physics-based boxes. Time is money, and safety is no concern… just try not to crash out!
items.description_ja: 世界で「最も効率的」な倉庫、DE NILE SHIPPINGで働こう。注文はカオスになっていくばかり。最大4人のオンライン協力プレイで、物理演算ベースで動く貨物箱をさばき切れ。時は金なり、安全性は二の次なり…ただし、クラッシュアウトはしないように！
items.title: Crashout Crew

items.description: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.
items.description_ja: 鬼教師1人 VS イタズラ生徒7人！最大8人で遊べる対戦パーティーゲーム。生徒は数十人のNPC生徒に紛れて、つまみ食いやスマホいじりのミッションをこっそり達成しよう。先生の目標は、隠れたイタズラ生徒を全員捕まえること。教室の平和を取り戻せ！
items.title: Worst Class Ever

items.description:
DWARF COMBAT! Stonewards is a 1-4 player co-op first-person roguelite defense game. Lead a crew of stubborn
dwarves from your base camp to aid nearby kingdoms, mine deep for resources, forge powerful
upgrades, and hold the line against relentless monster attacks.
items.description_ja: ドワーフたちよ、戦いへ！Stonewardsは、1〜4人協力プレイ対応の一人称視点ローグライト防衛ゲームです。拠点キャンプから頑固なドワーフたちを率いて近隣の王国を助け、地中深くで資源を採掘し、強力なアップグレードを鍛造し、容赦ないモンスターの襲撃に立ち向かいましょう。
items.title: Stonewards

items.description: Build a top-tier business solo or in co-op (1–6 players). Start from scratch, keep the slot machines spinning and deal with chaotic events like vandals and alien invasions. Grow your fortune and show everyone why the house always wins.
items.description_ja: ソロまたは協力プレイ（1～6人）で一流ビジネスを築こう。ゼロから始め、ゲストを楽しませ、破壊行為やトラブル、さらには宇宙からの訪問者まで、あらゆる混乱に対処せよ。
items.title: The House Always Wins

items.description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–6 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.
items.description_ja: S.O.N.A.R.（Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready）は、1～6人用オンライン協力型潜水艦シム。チームワークは必須、パニックは不可避、沈没はボタンの押し間違いひとつで目前です。sonarを使い、操縦し、戦い、修理し、仲間が何をすべきか分かっていることを祈りましょう。
items.title: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready

items.description: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!
items.description_ja: 『Dumb Ways to Build』は、物理演算ベースのドタバタ協力型建築ゲーム。フレンドと協力してチームを組み、危険な建設仕事を引き受けろ。装備が一人前なだけのド素人でも、力を合わせて道を切り拓こう。さもなくば挑戦して死ぬのみ！
items.title: Dumb Ways to Build

items.description: Bar After Bar is a multiplayer game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?
items.description_ja: Bar After Bar is a multiplayer game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?
items.title: Bar After Bar

items.description: Tasty Chef is a cozy restaurant management and cooking game where you build and expand unique restaurants, design menus, order ingredients, prepare dishes step by step, hire helpful staff, and serve customers alone or with friends.
items.description_ja: 『Tasty Chef』は、のんびり楽しめるレストラン経営＆クッキングゲームです。注文を受け、食材を準備し、料理を作ってお客さんをもてなしましょう。食材の仕入れや店舗の拡張、設備の配置、メニューのアレンジも自由自在。スタッフを雇い、ミルクティーショップから寿司屋へと事業を広げ、自分だけのグルメビジネスを育てましょう！
items.title: Tasty Chef

items.description: Review with caution.
items.description_ja: Review with caution.
items.title: Playable Archive

items.description: A fancy party brawler for proper scoundrels! Sling traps, swing bats, and fire cannons in destructible arenas as you scramble for absurd perks and weapons. Outlast your so-called peers by any gentlemanly means necessary - all in the name of good sport, of course.
items.description_ja: 折り目正しい悪党のための、お上品な乱闘ゲームが爆誕！破壊可能なアリーナでカオスなパークや武器を奪い合い、罠を仕掛け、バットを振り回し、大砲をぶっ放そう。ジェントルマンの名に恥じぬあらゆる手段を講じて、フェアプレイの名の下に高貴な同胞たちを出し抜くのだ。
items.title: A Gentlemen's Dispute

items.description: Welcome to a sinful night with the galaxy’s wackiest aliens. Play twisted tabletop games with up to 4 players, devise brilliant strategies, bluff your way to victory, and try not to lose your head - literally.
items.description_ja: 銀河で最も奇抜なエイリアンたちと過ごす、嘘と策略の罪の夜へようこそ。最大4人で遊べる月面テーブルゲームで、4種類のユニークなゲームモードを収録。仲間と共に策略を巡らせ、ブラフを仕掛け、勝利を掴め。そして忘れるな——自分の頭（理性）を守れ。本当に爆発するかも！
items.title: Bogos Binted?

items.description: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.
items.description_ja: 呪われたボードゲームを巡る、協力プレイ型のサバイバルホラー。忘れ去られたゲーム盤、打ち捨てられた屋敷。最大6人で同時プレイ可能。ダイスを振って、召喚される恐怖を生き延び、ゲームマスターを倒して自由を掴もう！
items.title: Invokyr

items.description: You’re a wizard! And a secret agent. The evil S.P.I.D.E.R crime syndicate has taken over your school, creating chaos. Play solo or up to 4 player co-op as you duel students, discover ancient secrets, and use scandalous spells.
items.description_ja: キミは魔法使いにして、秘密諜報員！ 国際犯罪組織S.P.I.D.E.Rに魔法学校が乗っ取られ、校内は大混乱だ！ 学生たちと決闘し、古代の秘密を探り、ヤッバい魔法をぶっ放そう！（1人または最大4人の協力プレイに対応）
items.title: Secret Agent Wizard Boy

items.description: Remote work simulator where you are a worm :)
items.description_ja: ミミズ視点で体験するリモートワークシミュレーター :)
items.title: Worming from Home

items.description: Say your moves out loud, trash-talk your friends, and fight to win. Smack Talk is a 1–8 player online PvP platform fighter where your voice controls your attacks. Call moves, land one-liners, and finish foes with wild ultimates.
items.description_ja: Say your moves out loud, trash-talk your friends, and fight to win. Smack Talk is a 1–8 player online PvP platform fighter where your voice controls your attacks. Call moves, land one-liners, and finish foes with wild ultimates.
items.title: Smack Talk

items.description: The original cooking horror returns in an unhinged co-op experience for 1-4 players. Grill burgers, serve customers, and hit your quota before the kitchen turns into a nightmare. When Asset Joy begins her hunt, try to escape alive and extract your hard-earned cash to survive another shift.
items.description_ja: あのクッキングホラーの原点が、1～4人で楽しめる狂気の協力プレイになって帰ってきました。ハンバーガーを焼き、お客様に料理を提供し、キッチンが悪夢と化す前にノルマを達成しましょう。アセットジョイが狩りを始めたら、生きて脱出し、苦労して稼いだお金を持ち出して、次のシフトを生き延びましょう。
items.title: Happy's Humble Burger Cult

items.description: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.
items.description_ja: 最大8人で遊べる、非対称型ホラーコメディ協力ゲーム。レストランを台無しにしようとするネズミの群れか、それを阻止しようとするシェフのどちらかになってプレイしよう。
items.title: Rat Game

items.description: Lead a better life than your friends in this competitive life simulator! Walk of Life offers unique roles and quirky playstyles to come out ahead! Duke it out with up to 6 players, or by yourself, in this hilarious party game!
items.description_ja: 対決ライフシミュ『Walk of Life』で、ユニークなロールと奇抜なプレイスタイルで優位に立ち、友達よりもいい人生を送ろう！ この陽気なパーティーゲームで、最大6人と、もしくはソロで、決着がつくまで戦うのだ！
items.title: Walk of Life

items.description: You're trapped in an apartment with ever-changing rooms. Capture anomalies on camera, survive deadly entities and escape an endless nightmare.
items.description_ja: あなたは、部屋が絶えず変化するアパートに閉じ込められています。カメラで異常を記録し、致命的な存在から生き延び、終わりのない悪夢から脱出しましょう。
items.title: CAPTURED 2

items.description: A slow-burn folk farming horror. You bought an isolated farm to start a new life. Your peaceful routine is shattered when the former owner's terrible secrets rise from beneath the ground.
items.description_ja: あなたは人里離れた農場を買い、新たな生活を始める。しかし、過去の所有者の恐るべき秘密が地の底から蘇り、平穏な日常は崩れ去っていく。ジワジワと盛り上がる田舎ホラー作品。
items.title: Dread Fields

items.description: PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR // ANTI-DATING SIM about learning to say NO.
items.description_ja: 心理ホラー // アンチ恋愛シミュレーション。『NO』と言えるようになる物語。
items.title: [Bober Bros] No Means Nothing

items.description: Last Train Outta' Wormtown is a chaotic Sandworm vs. Cowboys showdown. The Worm can only detect players touching the sand, like "hot lava" with a giant sandworm twist! Work together, Complete the objectives, and get outta' Wormtown! - Or, play as the Worm and gobble up your friends!
items.description_ja: 『Last Train Outta' Wormtown』では、サンドワームとカウボーイがカオスなバトルを繰り広げる。ワームは砂に触れているプレイヤーしか感知できない。砂に触れたら、巨大サンドワームの餌食になってしまうかも！ 協力しながら目標をクリアし、ワームタウンから脱出しよう！ あるいは、ワームとして友達にかぶりつけ！
items.title: Last Train Outta' Wormtown

items.description: Keflings may be small, but their kingdom-building adventures are gigantic! Build a world with your friends in A World of Keflings! Harvest resources, construct robots, befriend a dragon, and help a creepy witch get even creepier in this update of the classic 2010 city-building adventure.
items.description_ja: ケフリングは小さいかもしれませんが、彼らの王国建設の冒険は巨大です。A World of Keflings で友達と一緒に世界を構築しましょう。2010 年の古典的な都市建設アドベンチャーのこのアップデートで、資源を収穫し、ロボットを組み立て、ドラゴンと友達になり、不気味な魔女がさらに不気味になるのを手伝ってください。
items.title: A World of Keflings

items.description: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.
items.description_ja: 小さな植物店を経営しながら、深夜のお客さんのために植物を作る、心温まるホラーゲーム。植物コレクションを増やし、店をアップグレードして、ビジネスを成長させましょう。
items.title: The Plant Shop

items.description: Can you tell the difference between truth and tale? Experience three short horror stories and gather clues as to which are true and which are just part of our imagination. Immerse yourself in the protagonist's perspective and discover eerie tales from around the world.
items.description_ja: あなたは現実と作り話の違いを見分けることができますか？3つの短いホラーストーリーを体験し、どれが真実で、どれが単なる想像の一部なのかについての手がかりを集めてください。主人公の視点に没入し、世界中の不気味な物語を発見しましょう。
items.title: Tales of Fear - Episode Zero

items.description: A first-person action game, inspired by Dark Messiah, that provides various ways for defeating your foes, with weaponry, sorcery, stealth, or clever tactics like kicking them into deadly spikes.
items.description_ja: A first-person action game, inspired by Dark Messiah, that provides various ways for defeating your foes, with weaponry, sorcery, stealth, or clever tactics like kicking them into deadly spikes.
items.title: The Adventures of Sir Kicksalot

items.description: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.
items.description_ja: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.
items.title: Dawson Oaks Trailer Park

items.description: KILL IT WITH FIRE! 2 is the ultimate co-op spider-hunting experience! Either solo or as a team of Exterminators, unleash an arsenal of crazy weapons, wreak havoc, and complete dozens of challenges across seven dimensions under spider siege.
items.description_ja: 『Kill It With Fire 2』は究極の協力型クモ狩り体験を楽しめるゲームだ！沢山のハチャメチャな武器を携えた駆除人（一人でも集団でも可）となって破壊の限りを尽くし、クモの脅威にさらされた7つの次元で数多くのチャレンジを達成していこう。
items.title: KILL IT WITH FIRE! 2

items.description: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute & cozy puzzle adventure. Play as Traveller, a forest spirit on a special journey, as you explore magical hand-drawn locations, meet charming characters, solve handcrafted puzzles, collect herbs and tea recipes, and help the forest prepare for the coming winter.
items.description_ja: ヒューッ——落ち葉を舞い散らせる秋風がひと吹き！ ドングリリュックを背負い、カサカサと落ち葉を踏む音とともに森を探索しましょう。ひらめきいっぱいのミニゲームで、動物たちの冬支度をお手伝い。出会った友達に温かいお茶をいれ、現実の疲れをそっと吹き消してみませんか？
items.title: Tukoni: Forest Keepers

items.description: Explore, talk, and solve puzzles with cards in a solo tabletop adventure! Play as Alice, a girl trapped in the Beyond. Drag cards to craft items, meet curious companions, and find your way home. Stuck? Try a different card—and a different approach. This charming fairy-tale world has its secrets.
items.description_ja: カードで探索、交渉、謎解き！ひとりで楽しめる、TRPG風のカードアドベンチャー。異世界「彼岸」に迷い込んだ少女アリスとなり、カードをドラッグして町を探索し、道具を作り、個性豊かな仲間たちと元の世界へ帰る方法を探しましょう。困ったときは、別のカードで違うアプローチを。ただし、この可愛らしいおとぎ話の世界には、不穏な秘密が隠されています。
items.title: Alice Nation

items.description: Spend one last afternoon exploring your childhood neighborhood before the world ends at 6:38 PM.
items.description_ja: Spend one last afternoon exploring your childhood neighborhood before the world ends at 6:38 PM.
items.title: Eternal Afternoon

items.description: the cabin game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...
items.description_ja: the cabin game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...
items.title: the cabin game

items.description: Explore your decaying mind in this story driven retro survival horror FPS. Manage scarce resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way back to the living.
items.description_ja: ストーリー主導のレトロサバイバルホラーFPSで、崩壊していく自分の心を探索せよ。乏しい資源を管理し、パズルを解き、生者の世界へと戦いながら戻れ。
items.title: Comatose

items.description: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.
items.description_ja: なぜこの研究所に巨大な卵があるのか？ ミッションはいたってシンプルだ。卵を割ること。 余計なことは考えるな。 『CRACK』は、1～4人用の協力型インクリメンタル・アドベンチャーゲーム。 目的はただひとつ――謎の巨大な卵を割り、その中に何が隠されているのかを突き止めることだ。
items.title: CRACK

items.description: Welcome to the fantastic party on the adorable planet of chicks! Feather Party is a multiplayer party game for up to 8 players. Engage in a diverse array of fun mini-games with friends or against rivals to be the winner of this party!  Enjoy the exciting Board Game Mode.🐣
items.description_ja: Welcome to the fantastic party on the adorable planet of chicks! Feather Party is a multiplayer party game for up to 8 players. Engage in a diverse array of fun mini-games with friends or against rivals to be the winner of this party!  Enjoy the exciting Board Game Mode.🐣
items.title: Feather Party

items.description: Scam Line is a 4–8 player social deception game where your party will face different challenges. Become a liar, a manipulator, a cheater, or find your own path to victory
items.description_ja: Scam Lineは4～8人向けのソーシャル・デセプションゲームです。あなたのパーティーはさまざまな試練に直面します。嘘つきになるもよし、策略家になるもよし、イカサマ師になるもよし。あるいは、自分だけの勝利への道を見つけてください
items.title: Scam Line

items.description: Score goals with dungballs in Beetleball, the Greatest Online Multiplayer Class-based Dung Beetle Soccer Game TO EVER EXIST
items.description_ja: 史上最高のオンラインマルチプレイヤー・クラス制・糞虫サッカーゲームのビートルボールで糞玉のゴールを決めましょう
items.title: Beetleball

items.description: A creepy-cozy co-op fishing game for 1–6 players with proximity voice chat. Fish a haunted swamp, take odd jobs from the locals, fill Dock Quotas with your crew, and try to survive what hunts you in the dark.
items.description_ja: 近接ボイスチャット対応、1～4人用の不気味で心地いい協力釣りゲーム。呪われた沼を探索し、レアな魚を釣り、釣果を重さで売りさばき、闇の中であなたを狩る“何か”から生き延びましょう。
items.title: Voodoo Fishin'

items.description: Get ready to drink and drive (safely). Challenge friends in multiple drinking and driving game modes, like drunk cop chases, pedestrians, races, capture the flag, hot potato, and more! With options to change the style of play, there is so much drunk driving fun!
items.description_ja: Get ready to drink and drive (safely). Challenge friends in multiple drinking and driving game modes, like drunk cop chases, pedestrians, races, capture the flag, hot potato, and more! With options to change the style of play, there is so much drunk driving fun!
items.title: Intoxicated Driver

items.description:
UP! UP! UP! It's the only thought you can still grasp. You have an infection that started in your foot, now it's in your head.
Meet strange neighbours, make bad trades, learn about them. Everytime you fail, the building stays the same. What changes is what you know.
items.description_ja:
UP! UP! UP! It's the only thought you can still grasp. You have an infection that started in your foot, now it's in your head.
Meet strange neighbours, make bad trades, learn about them. Everytime you fail, the building stays the same. What changes is what you know.
items.title: MOLDRISE

items.description:
JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to Feed The Pit.

Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!
items.description_ja:
JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to Feed The Pit.

Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!
items.title: Feed The Pit

items.description: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.
items.description_ja: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.
items.title: Airport Security Sucks!

items.description: A prince who has lost his kingdom and everything else. His uncle and aide-de-camp, unable to leave him. In a cramped rented room abroad, click on objects and piece together a codependent relationship filled with brutality and endurance. Watch helplessness turn into violence, tenderness into torture.
items.description_ja:
すべてを失った亡国の王子。彼を見捨てられない、叔父であり副官でもある男。異国の部屋でオブジェクトをクリックしながら、二人の共依存の記憶を追う。
無力さが暴力に、愛情が拷問に変わっていく様子を見る。
items.title: Dissolution of My Self

items.description: Lumina Veil, a horror game with a modern twist! Step into the shoes of a popular streamer on a journey into a strange new game. As you dive deeper, you'll find yourself escaping the isolation of your own world, only to discover that the lines between fantasy and reality are beginning to blur.
items.description_ja: Lumina Veil, a horror game with a modern twist! Step into the shoes of a popular streamer on a journey into a strange new game. As you dive deeper, you'll find yourself escaping the isolation of your own world, only to discover that the lines between fantasy and reality are beginning to blur.
items.title: Lumina Veil

items.description: A cinematic, story-driven alien horror set in 1999 Ohio. Work the night shift at a remote gas station. A mysterious briefcase from the lake. Stolen uranium fuel. A blood-covered coworker.
items.description_ja: 1999年のオハイオ州を舞台にした、映画のような演出で描くストーリー重視のエイリアンホラー。人里離れたガソリンスタンドで夜勤をする。湖から引き上げられた謎のブリーフケース。盗まれたウラン燃料。血まみれの同僚。
items.title: [HERROR] Gas Station Case

items.description: Trapped in an infinite shift, you are the sole clerk of purgatory’s only convenience store. Manage stock, pay your taxes and keep nightmarish creatures at bay as you uncover the secret of why your shift never ends. Clock in. Serve the dead. Survive the shift.
items.description_ja: 燃え盛る地獄にただ一軒だけ存在するコンビニ。君は終わらないシフトに囚われた唯一のコンビニ店員。在庫を管理し、税金を払い、 夜ごと現れる悪夢のようなクリーチャーを食い止めながら、なぜこのシフトに終わりがないのか、その真実を暴け。出勤し、死者に奉仕し、シフトを生き延びろ。
items.title: Retail Hell

items.description: A heartfelt game where you run a night market stall, cooking kaolengmian (grilled cold noodles). Customers come and go, stopping by to chat and share bits of their lives, joys, frustrations, and everyday struggles. At this little stall, you cook, listen, and keep living an ordinary person’s life.
items.description_ja: 夜市の暮らしと普通の人々の物語を描く経営シミュレーションゲーム。あなたは屋台の店主として、鉄板で焼冷麺を手際よく焼き上げる。夜の街を行き交う人々が足を止め、何気ない会話を交わす。仕事の愚痴、夢の話、ほんの少しの寂しさ、それらが煙と灯りに溶けていく。この小さな屋台で、あなたは料理をし、人に触れ、そして自分の人生を静かに生きていく。
items.title: Chinese Street Food Legend

items.description: Secretly playing your Generic-90s-Handheld-Video-Game-Console during a first date? Shame on you!
items.description_ja: Secretly playing your Generic-90s-Handheld-Video-Game-Console during a first date? Shame on you!
items.title: DateBoy

items.description: Up to 15 players redub video clips and give them a whole new meaning. You record the scene, then watch every result together and vote. With voice effects, a built-in clip editor and live voting from your Twitch chat.
items.description_ja: Up to 15 players redub video clips and give them a whole new meaning. You record the scene, then watch every result together and vote. With voice effects, a built-in clip editor and live voting from your Twitch chat.
items.title: Dub Together

items.description: Go on heists through Midnight City alone or with up to four players to fulfill tasks as a hacker for various organizations. Improve your reputation, earn money, and uncover the secrets of shady companies all while being hunted by terrifying entities.
items.description_ja: Go on heists through Midnight City alone or with up to four players to fulfill tasks as a hacker for various organizations. Improve your reputation, earn money, and uncover the secrets of shady companies all while being hunted by terrifying entities.
items.title: Midnight Heist

items.description: This is a horror type anomaly finding game, where you accidentally enter a strange room where a demon Kun Kun lives for two and a half years. Kun Kun likes to tease people who enter its room. It is capricious, sometimes dancing happily, sometimes crying sadly, sometimes hunting with anger, and sometimes making you laugh. If you want to escape from here, you can only judge if there is any abnormality in this infinite loop room. You can escape from here by making 8 consecutive judgments.
items.description_ja: うっかり坤坤の巣に入り込んでしまったあなた、そこには非常に恐ろしい悪魔坤坤がいて、獲物を驚かせるのが大好きです。部屋に異変を感じたら、すぐに逃げ出してください。
items.title: KunKunNest

items.description: A 1-8 player co-op sci-fi looter horror game that takes place on a mysterious asteroid belt where players must complete contracts by traveling to exotic planets to kill creatures, find loot, and/or farm planetary materials that they must return to an ominous figure named Sketchy.
items.description_ja: A 1-8 player co-op sci-fi looter horror game that takes place on a mysterious asteroid belt where players must complete contracts by traveling to exotic planets to kill creatures, find loot, and/or farm planetary materials that they must return to an ominous figure named Sketchy.
items.title: Sketchy's Contract

items.description: Stranded on a desolate island with Earth's remaining researchers, you investigate a strange celestial body. The day before departure, your only means of transportation gets mysteriously damaged, leaving you stranded. Is someone sabotaging the team, or is there something more sinister going on…
items.description_ja: 狂気の超現実的ポイント&クリックホラー。君は島で目を覚まし、地球に残された数少ない研究者たちと共に島に落下した謎の天体を調査する。帰還を目前にしたある日、唯一の移動手段が故障し島に留まることを余儀なくされた。誰かが意図的に妨害しているのか――それとも、島そのものが君たちを抹殺しようとしているのか？
items.title: The Dream Of A Cockspur

items.description: A two-player co-op horror escape. Trapped in a haunted manor, you’ll need to solve puzzles, work together, and trust each other to make it out alive.
items.description_ja: A two-player co-op horror escape. Trapped in a haunted manor, you’ll need to solve puzzles, work together, and trust each other to make it out alive.
items.title: We Escaped a Twisted Game

items.description: Explore an abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. Uncover the mystery of your best friend’s disappearance. Dodge bullets.
items.description_ja: Explore an abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. Uncover the mystery of your best friend’s disappearance. Dodge bullets.
items.title: Yuki「清醒梦」

items.description: There's Nothing Down There is a short undersea horror exploration game. Descend into a sinkhole at the bottom of the ocean and discover the remains of a lost, yet not dead, civilization. Now available in VR!
items.description_ja: 『There's Nothing Down There』は、深海を舞台にした短編ホラー探索ゲームです。海底のシンクホールへと潜り、失われたはずの、しかし今なお息づく文明の遺構を発見しましょう。
items.title: There's Nothing Down There

items.description: TYPE TO KILL in this survival horror adventure. Alone or with friends, explore a sprawling cursed film studio as its horror movies bleed into reality. Choose from a roster of characters then plan your escape from this bloody homage to old school horror. But remember... death is just a typo away.
items.description_ja: このサバイバルホラーアドベンチャーで「タイプして倒せ」。一人でも友達と一緒でも、広大な呪われた映画スタジオを探索し、そのホラー映画が現実に溢れ出してくる。キャラクターを選び、この血まみれの古典ホラーへのオマージュから脱出計画を立てよう。しかし、忘れないでください…死はタイプミス一つで訪れるのです。
items.title: Blood Typers

items.description: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in LOVE ETERNAL, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative. Find a way out - or live in Shelter forever more.
items.description_ja:
重力を反転させ、忌まわしき記憶が築きし城を行け。正確な操作と瞬時の判断で、100以上のステージを踏破せよ。
家族から引き離された孤独な少女マヤを待ち受けるのは、不気味で鮮烈な世界、そして恐るべき秘密－－。走り、跳び、重力を反転させる中で、この世界もまた、理解を超えてねじれていく。
items.title: LOVE ETERNAL

items.description: Big E’s back in action! Working the farm over Summer is never easy - but everyone knows you’re the best. Do your utmost to keep the product moving, the customers happy and the law at bay, and everything’ll turn out great!
items.description_ja: Big E’s back in action! Working the farm over Summer is never easy - but everyone knows you’re the best. Do your utmost to keep the product moving, the customers happy and the law at bay, and everything’ll turn out great!
items.title: Jeffrey Eggstein

items.description: Grandpa wants two ice creams. Grandma is dead and left you 100 kroner. An absurdist Norwegian first-person shooter in PSX style, about getting two ice creams through the bank, the police, Lånekassa and the cashier lady at KJIWI. Nobody comments on any of it.
items.description_ja: Grandpa wants two ice creams. Grandma is dead and left you 100 kroner. An absurdist Norwegian first-person shooter in PSX style, about getting two ice creams through the bank, the police, Lånekassa and the cashier lady at KJIWI. Nobody comments on any of it.

items.description: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.
items.description_ja: 『勇者パーティはぜんめつしました。』は、壊れてしまった仲間の〈業〉と向き合い、一緒にケジメをつける高湿度・激重感情RPGです。壊滅した勇者パーティから1人だけを救出し、ダンジョンから脱出しましょう。限界状況のなか生まれる感情は、絆か、疑心か、依存か。
items.title: Annihilated

items.description: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.

items.description: Too Many Toys! is a cozy organizing simulator where you'll sort 5,517 toys in a messy toy shop. Put every toy back in its correct place, complete rows to gain points, and spend them on upgrades that make organizing faster and more satisfying!
items.description_ja: Too Many Toys!は、散らかったおもちゃ屋さんで5,599個のおもちゃを整理する、癒やし系の整理シミュレーションゲームです。すべてのおもちゃを正しい場所に戻し、列を完成させてポイントを獲得しましょう。ポイントを使ってアップグレードを購入すれば、整理がもっと素早く、もっと気持ちよくなります！

Left alone as your little village’s last hope, you: Domingo, know what you must do to save your people and also pull a hot date, and that is to do what you know best: Romance the dragon attacking your home!

items.description: CRYO is a multiplayer co-op survival horror for 1-4 players. You have been deployed by your company to various locations around the Antarctic due to communication issues. What awaits you in these dark, remote regions is far more sinister than a technical fault...
items.description_ja: CRYOは1～4人で遊べるマルチプレイ協力型サバイバルホラーゲームです。通信障害の調査のため、あなたは会社から南極各地のさまざまな施設へ派遣されます。しかし、その暗く人里離れた場所で待ち受けているものは、単なる技術的な故障などではありません……
items.title: CRYO

items.description: Restore order to three ransacked fantasy shops! Organize thousands of items, master helpful sorceries and enchantments, relax at your own pace, race the global leaderboards, and unlock new ways to play. Every item has a shelf. Can you find them all?
items.description_ja: Restore order to three ransacked fantasy shops! Organize thousands of items, master helpful sorceries and enchantments, relax at your own pace, race the global leaderboards, and unlock new ways to play. Every item has a shelf. Can you find them all?
items.title: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop

items.description: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!
items.description_ja: ローグライクデッキビルダーの『Dogpile』で、かわいい犬たちを合体させて大きな犬を登場させましょう。犬たちと遊び、資金を集めて犬に特別な個性を加え、デッキをさらに進化。さあ、たくさんのワンちゃんたちがあなたを待っています！
items.title: Dogpile

items.description:
Manage the night shift of an ER during the apocalypse, solo or with friends online: Diagnose patients. Design and grow your hospital, and defend against the undead while treating the living. 
If you're a creator, connect the game to Twitch and make the audience your patients for even more fun!

items.description:
"Life sometimes feels like it’s going in circles."
Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why is a short pixel art Visual Novel
about a girl who tell herself this, forever.
Maybe you can try to help her ?
items.description_ja:
「時々、人生は同じ場所をぐるぐる回っているように感じる。」
Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why は短いピクセルアートのビジュアルノベルで、
一人の少女がこの言葉を永遠に自分に言い聞かせる物語です。
もしかしたら、あなたが彼女を助けられるかもしれません？
items.title: Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why

items.description:
可愛い後輩と2人っきり……冷凍庫の中で。
低体温症、矛盾脱衣、幻覚などの苦痛を乗り越えた先にあるのは、「真相」と「死」のみ。

items.description: Relive your childhood nostalgia at Goofy Gorillas, the largest virtual jungle gym! Battle it out with your friends in a wide range of casual but intense PvP gamemodes, or chill out and take part in some extra activities around the venue! Make the Goofy experience your own!

items.description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror roguelike.
items.description_ja: 生き残りたければ、最後尾から先頭まで薙ぎ払って突き進め！吹雪に閉ざされた車内で死角に身を潜めろ。待ち受けるのは、群れで凶暴化した血に飢えた「テディベア」。銃声は襲撃を招き、極寒は体温を奪う。弾丸を込めるか、最後の資金で車両を修理するか。情けを捨て、血肉の饗宴を生き抜け！
items.title: Fright Train

items.description: You and your crew are tasked with cleaning up after the last exploration team's ill-fated journey into the Backrooms. Dodge deadly incursions, scrub every surface, and leave no trace.
items.description_ja: あなたと清掃隊は、悲運に終わった前回の探検チームのBackrooms遠征の後始末を任されました。致命的なインカージョンを避けながら、すべての表面を磨き、痕跡を残さないようにしましょう。
items.title: Backrooms Cleanup Crew

items.description: In this survival horror, you're surrounded by sea and a towering gate ahead. Walk into the maze, hunt, gather, and run to survive, alone or with friends. Remember: You're not the only one starving...
items.description_ja: このサバイバルホラーでは、あなたは海に囲まれ、目の前にはそびえ立つ門があります。迷路に入り、狩り、採集し、生き延びるために走り抜けてください。一人でも、仲間と一緒でも。忘れないで…飢えているのはあなただけではありません。
items.title: MAZEBOUND: Hunt, Gather, Run!

items.description: Two girls must travel to the Moon's core after it has been thrown out of orbit. A PC98 inspired visual novel about fear of the unknown and people in love.
items.description_ja: Two girls must travel to the Moon's core after it has been thrown out of orbit. A PC98 inspired visual novel about fear of the unknown and people in love.

items.description: In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the Goblin King-Queen. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed them, and you might be the next meal!
items.description_ja: このオンラインホラーCo-opで、ケンカっ早いゴブリンとなって、ダンジョンを探索し、罠を回避し、モンスターから逃げ、ゴブリンのキングクイーンに食事を提供しよう。ゴブリン仲間とチームを組むもよし、一匹ゴブリンで行くもよし。ピットの深部へ潜り、混乱を引き起こせ！ 食事提供に失敗すれば、次に食べられるのは君かもしれない！

items.description: Embark on a journey to reunite with your bread in this bite-sized 3D action-platformer featuring everyone's favorite shark!

items.description_ja: 「オーロラヒルズ：チャプター2」は、ポイント＆クリックパズルアドベンチャーゲームシリーズの第2弾です。国立公園で発生した奇妙な失踪事件の調査を任されたパークレンジャー、イーサン・ヒルの旅を追いながら、オーロラヒルズの謎を解き明かしましょう！
items.title: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2

items.description_ja: A short medical simulation horror game with multiple endings where the imperfect are made HAPPY. Perform tasks and operations on sedated patients to fix their defects before submitting your files to the Ministry of Happiness & Peace!

The objective is to fulfill her desires by speaking to her beloved "him" causing poltergeists, visiting in dreams, or even cursing.

items.description_ja: プラットフォーマー式ゲームメーカー、レベルヘッドで自分のレベルを作り、プレイし、そして共有して競い合いましょう。レベルエディターが持つ深く直感的なシステムで挑戦的なレベルを作成し、それらを世界中に共有してフォローを獲得しましょう！

items.description_ja: 家賃が急に上がったため、森の奥にある驚くほど安い家へ引っ越すことになった。破格の家賃に職場も近い——幸運だと思ったが、まもなくこの家には何かおかしいところがあると気づく…。
