items.description: C.A.S.T is a third-person PvE extraction shooter playable solo or in co-op. Select your character and loadout to battle enemy hordes, evade anomalies, and complete objectives across handcrafted maps with dynamic procedural elements.
items.description_ja: C.A.S.T is a third-person PvE extraction shooter playable solo or in co-op. Select your character and loadout to battle enemy hordes, evade anomalies, and complete objectives across handcrafted maps with dynamic procedural elements.
items.title: C.A.S.T. (CHERNOZEM ANOMALY STRIKE TEAM)

items.description: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?
items.description_ja: CH13: Rest Stopは、2000年代初頭のポーランドを舞台にしたサイコロジカルホラーゲームです。森の中を穏やかにドライブするところから始まった旅は、やがてはるかに不穏なものへと変わっていきます…。道の果てに何が待ち受けているのか、あなたは突き止められるでしょうか？
items.title: CH13: Rest Stop

items.description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.
items.description_ja: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.
items.title: Playrooms

items.description: Online co-op chaos for 1 to 4 players in a space station hookah lounge. The gravity cuts out mid-shift, customers throw up, hot coals set people on fire and the shopping cart goes wherever it wants. Every dollar you make turns the dump into a two-floor lounge.
items.description_ja: 宇宙ステーションのシーシャラウンジを舞台にした、1〜4人のオンライン協力カオス。営業中に重力が消え、客は吐き、真っ赤な炭で誰かが燃え上がり、ショッピングカートは言うことを聞かない。稼いだお金でオンボロの店を2階建てのラウンジに育てよう。
items.title: Hubble Bubble

items.description: While looking for the existence of the Great Beyond, Professor Patrick Moore, aided by a fake medium, will build a device to see the other side, embark on a search for a millenary artifact, and investigate the most haunted manor of 1907 England.
items.description_ja: While looking for the existence of the Great Beyond, Professor Patrick Moore, aided by a fake medium, will build a device to see the other side, embark on a search for a millenary artifact, and investigate the most haunted manor of 1907 England.
items.title: An English Haunting

items.description: A short, linear story game of a random demon guy's life.
items.description_ja: A short, linear story game of a random demon guy's life.
items.title: Everyday Devil

items.description: The WWI story where your goal isn’t to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.
items.description_ja: The WWI story where your goal isn’t to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.
items.title: The Caribou Trail

items.description:
First-Person Adventure that focuses on Source-Engine inspired movement physics. Explore an impossibly huge research facility using physics-breaking abilities granted by a mysterious fossil monolith.
Evolve to reach new areas and fight strange machines roaming the laboratories.
items.description_ja:
First-Person Adventure that focuses on Source-Engine inspired movement physics. Explore an impossibly huge research facility using physics-breaking abilities granted by a mysterious fossil monolith.
Evolve to reach new areas and fight strange machines roaming the laboratories.
items.title: BAIONLENJA

items.description: In a game show starring only criminals, you must gamble against rival players to prove yourself worthy of being pardoned for your wrong deeds— But is the show really about proving your innocence? Jackpot Crash Course is a death game visual novel about crime, luck and spectacle.
items.description_ja: そのショーに出演できるのは犯罪者だけ。ライバル相手に賭けへ挑み、自らが罪の赦しに値すると証明しなければならない――だが、このショーは本当に無実を証明するためのものなのか？『Jackpot Crash Course』、犯罪・運・見世物がテーマのデスゲーム・ビジュアルノベル。
items.title: Jackpot Crash Course

items.description: Digital ED Treatment Center is a random launcher for players in a gaming slump. We help you rediscover the joy of play and unearth hidden gems buried in your library. Click to start your treatment and reignite your gaming vigor!
items.description_ja: 《デジタルED治療センター》はゲーム難民のためのランダムランチャー。埋もれた名作を掘り起こし、ゲームの喜びを再発見。今すぐ「治療」をクリックして、プレイヤーの雄姿を取り戻そう！
items.title: Gaming Burnout Treatment Center

items.description: MESMALIE is an occult adventure game. A magickal incident in your personal life brings you to a small witches' coven in the middle of nowhere. Here, you'll learn to tame your ability... though, not without some bumps along the way.
items.description_ja: MESMALIE is an occult adventure game. A magickal incident in your personal life brings you to a small witches' coven in the middle of nowhere. Here, you'll learn to tame your ability... though, not without some bumps along the way.
items.title: Mesmalie

items.description: The Pale Mimic is an atmospheric horror set in the untamed Alaskan wilderness. As a high profile fugitive on the run, it’s just you and your dog surviving in the chilling forests, until something else shows up uninvited.
items.description_ja: 『The Pale Mimic』は、アラスカの荒野を舞台にした大気感漂うホラーゲーム。指名手配犯として逃亡中の身であるあなたと愛犬は、凍てつく森で必死に生き延びていた。そこに「招かれざる客」が現れるまでは。
items.title: The Pale Mimic

items.description: A puzzle game starring mischievous fairies. Complete levels by working as a team, operating dangerous machinery and manipulating local wildlife.
items.description_ja: A puzzle game starring mischievous fairies. Complete levels by working as a team, operating dangerous machinery and manipulating local wildlife.
items.title: Poke ALL Toads

items.description: No packages? No problem! Break in. Scrap everything. Deliver... A chaotic online co-op game for up to 5 players (or 15 if you really want to)!
items.description_ja: 荷物がない？問題なし！押し入れ。全部バラせ。配達だ…最大5人（本気なら15人も）で遊べるカオスなオンライン協力ゲーム！
items.title: Delivery & Beyond

items.description: A horror co-op extraction builder set in a scorched wasteland where everything burns. Descend with your friends into shifting ruins, rip out furniture, and scavenge for loot before the Corrupted close in. Make it back alive, then rebuild the Outpost to better your chances for the next run.
items.description_ja: 協力型ホラー脱出系建築ゲーム、爆誕。全てが燃える焦土の荒野でフレンドを道連れに、形を変えていく遺跡へと降り立ち、家具をもぎ取って、戦利品を漁り、「腐敗」が迫る前に脱出だ。生還したら前哨基地を再建して、次の遺跡潜りの成功率を高めよう。
items.title: GRAIN ROT

items.description: Tiny cats have moved into your desktop. They pad around the screen, bat at your cursor, curl up to sleep somewhere, and suddenly break into a sprint in the middle of the night. Dote on their delightfully cat-like antics. Adopt two cats for free.
items.description_ja: デスクトップに小さな猫たちが引っ越してきました。デスクトップの中をとことこ歩き、カーソルにじゃれついて、どこかで丸くなって寝て、夜中には突然走り出します。猫っぽい行動をかわいがってあげてくださいね。無料で2匹の猫をお迎えできます。
items.title: Sill Cats

items.description: BLOOD VIAL is a retro-inspired micro-FPS with a leaking health bar. Swim through the spilled blood of your fallen enemies to keep your vial full. Grow increasingly powerful with new upgrades and weapons. Navigate an ever-shifting labyrinth of crypts, catacombs and cathedrals.
items.description_ja: BLOOD VIAL is a retro-inspired micro-FPS with a leaking health bar. Swim through the spilled blood of your fallen enemies to keep your vial full. Grow increasingly powerful with new upgrades and weapons. Navigate an ever-shifting labyrinth of crypts, catacombs and cathedrals.
items.title: Blood Vial

items.description: People across the kingdom are vanishing. Young hero Harold Sageblood is ordered by the king to defeat the mastermind behind it all. Joined by the loyal mage Martha Bethraeor, the hero sets out—seeking answers about his missing father and the truth behind the disappearances.
items.description_ja: 国民が次々に失踪する事件が起こる。この事件の黒幕を倒せと勇者に命ずる国王クロマーク。裏切らないと断言する勇者の仲間・魔道士マーシャ・ウラギール。勇者の父は旅立った後にどこにいってしまったのか。勇者達を待ち構える魔王ユウ・シャノチーチ。冒険の終わりに明かされる魔王の正体とは――
items.title: Heavy Spoilers RPG: The true identity of the final enemy is the hero's father

items.description: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.
items.description_ja: 『Entropy』は、名作JRPGに影響を受けた戦術的ターン制RPG。傭兵を集めてパーティを組み、デーモンの侵攻を阻止するために地獄への遠征を目指そう。旅の途中で下す選択が、この世界の運命を左右する。
items.title: Entropy

items.description: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop! is a single-player organizing game set in a chaotic video game store. Sort 4,290 cases by genre and order, fill 96 racks, progress and unlock powerful abilities, and complete 650 parody-filled series - with questionable help from Jeff, the coolest cat ever.
items.description_ja: 『Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!』は、大混乱に陥ったゲームショップを舞台にしたシングルプレイの整理整頓ゲーム。4,290個のゲームケースをジャンルと順番どおりに並べ、96台の棚を埋め、強力なスキルを解放し、650のパロディシリーズをコンプリートしよう。宇宙一クールな猫 Jeff の、きわめて怪しい手助け付きで。
items.title: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!

items.description: Start with nothing and spin your way to the top! Gather fruit from slot machines and sell them to buy upgrades, new fruit types, and more! Unlock cute customers! Meet a Bear Wizard! Build your fruit empire with Fruit Stand Fortune!
items.description_ja: Start with nothing and spin your way to the top! Gather fruit from slot machines and sell them to buy upgrades, new fruit types, and more! Unlock cute customers! Meet a Bear Wizard! Build your fruit empire with Fruit Stand Fortune!
items.title: Fruit Stand Fortune

items.description: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.
items.description_ja: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.
items.title: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones

items.description:
Stick with the same color, bounce off the rest! Snatch the soap, sabotage your friends!
Adorable jelly critters are here for chaotic, hilarious showdowns!

Supports 4-player local and up to 6-player online battles, plus a map editor so you can jump into laugh-out-loud matches anytime!
items.description_ja:
同じ色はくっついて、違う色は弾き飛ばせ！石けんを奪い合って、フレンドをハメろ！
キュートなゼリーモンスターたちのドタバタ対戦が開幕！

ローカル4人 / オンライン最大6人対戦対応、
さらにマップエディター搭載で、いつでも爆笑バトル！
items.title: Jelly Bubble

items.description: First-person psychological horror about ignorance and attempts. Protect yourself as a lone carpenter, hastily look for materials in your house to board up a door that shouldn’t exist. At any cost.
items.description_ja: 無知と試みについての、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー。孤独な大工として身を守り、存在するはずのないドアを塞ぐために、家の中の材料を急いで探してください。どんな犠牲を払っても。
items.title: Box of Broken Nails

items.description: What, you don’t know Toilet 8 🚽💩? The most immature parody anomaly game ever made? You’re stuck in a loop of public toilets where you must spot what’s wrong each time. Absurd surprises and plenty of poop-fart humor designed to make you laugh.
items.description_ja: え、Toilet 8 🚽💩を知らない？世界一くだらないパロディ系異変ゲーム。公衆トイレのループに閉じ込められ、毎回どこがおかしいかを見抜く。バカバカしい驚きと下品なトイレ系ユーモア満載。
items.title: Toilet 8

items.description: A horror game where you play a hand-held console in the backseat during a long drive home.
items.description_ja: A horror game where you play a hand-held console in the backseat during a long drive home.
items.title: The Deadseat

items.description: Backroom Company (aka Axiom Corporation) is a mysterious group exploring “Noclip.” No one knows who created it. Follow the missing explorers' traces and find strange items deep in the Backrooms.
items.description_ja: バックルームカンパニー（以下、Axiom Corporation）は、ランダムに繋がれた空間「ノークリップ」を探索する謎の企業です。誰が、なぜこの会社を作ったのかは誰にもわかりません。多くの探検者がこの空間で姿を消しており、あなたは彼らの痕跡を辿ってバックルームの奥に隠された奇妙なアイテムを見つけなければなりません。
items.title: Backroom Company

items.description: A small-scale horror escape game that breaks the usual genre mold. The player must escape from a house where a deranged grandfather has locked them in. But the real fear lies not in the jump scares, but in the oppressive reality of the house and its hidden corners.
items.description_ja: A small-scale horror escape game that breaks the usual genre mold. The player must escape from a house where a deranged grandfather has locked them in. But the real fear lies not in the jump scares, but in the oppressive reality of the house and its hidden corners.
items.title: DEDA

items.description: Tidy Up History is a cozy cleaning sim where you inherit a chaotic museum. Tidy messy rooms, unlock new abilities, and find hidden keys to open new wings. Uncover historical knowledge to properly identify and showcase artifacts, returning the museum to its former glory.
items.description_ja: Tidy Up History は、散らかった博物館を受け継いで再建していく、癒やし系のお片付けシミュレーションゲームです。乱雑な展示室を整理し、新たな能力を解放しながら、隠された鍵を見つけて新しいエリアを開放しましょう。歴史の知識を学び、遺物を正しく鑑定・展示して、博物館をかつての栄光へと取り戻してください。
items.title: Tidy Up History

items.description: A macabre ritual murder puts Arkham PD detectives Jack Foster and Harvey Whitman to the test. As the investigation progresses, they will unveil a disturbing connection between the Salem witch trials of the 17th century and the end of humankind.
items.description_ja: A macabre ritual murder puts Arkham PD detectives Jack Foster and Harvey Whitman to the test. As the investigation progresses, they will unveil a disturbing connection between the Salem witch trials of the 17th century and the end of humankind.
items.title: The Dark Rites of Arkham

items.description:
Heaven Does Not Respond is a psychological and analog horror game set in an alternate 2005 timeline.

Play as an intelligence agent, exploring a retro computer interface to decipher secret files, watch mysterious videos, and uncover the dark secrets behind a young man's death.
items.description_ja:
Heaven Does Not Respondは、2005年の架空のタイムラインを舞台にした、心理的でアナログなホラーゲームです。

諜報員としてレトロなコンピューターインターフェースを探索し、秘密のファイルを解読し、謎のビデオを視聴し、ある若者の死に隠された暗い秘密を暴き出しましょう。
items.title: Heaven Does Not Respond

items.description: This is a simple love story set in a modern city, featuring me and three girls. The story takes place in the company where I work as a supervisor. Together with the three women, The game follows a linear narrative, with hundreds of video clips providing branching choices for the players.
items.description_ja: This is a simple love story set in a modern city, featuring me and three girls. The story takes place in the company where I work as a supervisor. Together with the three women, The game follows a linear narrative, with hundreds of video clips providing branching choices for the players.
items.title: Soul Touch

items.description: "Survivor's Notes" is an FMV . Players control two protagonists, using choices and QTEs to unlock different branches and endings.  Follow a girl who foresees disaster and acolonel from the future as their stories reveal the outbreak's origins. Trust,rescue, or walk away. Survival is onlyone of them.
items.description_ja: "Survivor's Notes" is an FMV . Players control two protagonists, using choices and QTEs to unlock different branches and endings.  Follow a girl who foresees disaster and acolonel from the future as their stories reveal the outbreak's origins. Trust,rescue, or walk away. Survival is onlyone of them.
items.title: Survivor's Notes

items.description: A chill exploration game where EVERYTHING goes in the boot! You're Alp, a lil' golem on a quest to find his purpose. Run, climb, and use items as fuel in your Rocket Boot to blast yourself into the air!
items.description_ja: A chill exploration game where EVERYTHING goes in the boot! You're Alp, a lil' golem on a quest to find his purpose. Run, climb, and use items as fuel in your Rocket Boot to blast yourself into the air!
items.title: Tall Trails

items.description: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.
items.description_ja:
地下世界へ向かう特殊部隊の生死は、あなたにかかっています。
あなたは管制室からモニターやレーダーを確認し、無線で隊員へ指示を出します。
全員を生還へ導きながら、深淵に潜む"太古の何か"の正体を暴いてください。
items.title: Below, Rusted Gods

items.description: Build a strong defense of hololive dolls to defeat a robot army in this exciting hololive-themed tower defense game!!
items.description_ja: ホロライブをテーマにした白熱のタワーディフェンスが登場！！ 「ホロドール」たちで強力な防衛線を築き、迫りくるロボット軍団を撃退せよ！
items.title: Holo vs Robo

items.description: A turn-based horror RPG with retro 32-bit 3D graphics. Survive the horrors of the mansion that changes every time you enter.
items.description_ja: A turn-based horror RPG with retro 32-bit 3D graphics. Survive the horrors of the mansion that changes every time you enter.
items.title: House of Necrosis

items.description: It has been -̷̯͙̔̈́-̴̱̽̓͝-̷̍̊̕͠   days without incident. Your investigation has brought you to an old metalworks factory, abandoned after a series of mysterious deaths. But something’s been growing in the quiet. A short first-person survival horror experience.
items.description_ja: -̷̯͙̔̈́-̴̱̽̓͝-̷̍̊̕͠   日間 事故無し。調査の末、あなたは不審な連続死亡事件の後、廃墟となった古い金属工場へと辿り着いた。しかし、静寂の中で何かが蠢き始めている。短編の一人称視点サバイバルホラー。
items.title: Days Without Incident

items.description: Stranded in the desert, your only hope of escaping rests in a strange Catman. His one request: hunt down surreal creatures, skin them, and chop them up so he can keep them as trophies.
items.description_ja: 砂漠で立ち往生したあなたの唯一の脱出手段は、奇妙なネコ男。彼のただひとつの願いは、シュールなクリーチャーを狩り、剥ぎ、刻み、トロフィーとして持ち帰ること。この不気味な世界では、“死”がすぐそばにある存在になる。
items.title: Cat Named Mojave

items.description: The only game in the world that's more anticipated than GTA VI. Pih 2 is a one-hit-kill comedy FPS. Fight various types of enemy pihs and bosses in increasingly ridiculous situations, dodge instant death and try not to rage when everything goes wrong.
items.description_ja: 世界で唯一、GTA VI以上に待ち望まれているゲーム。Pih 2は、一撃で決着するコメディFPSだ。ますますバカげていく状況で、さまざまな敵のブタやボスと戦い、即死をかわし、すべてが台無しになってもキレないように耐えろ。
items.title: Pih 2

items.description: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 16 year old were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...
items.description_ja: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 16 year old were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...
items.title: [Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident

items.description: Explore abandoned biospheres at the bottom of the ocean, alone or with up to 4 friends.
items.description_ja: Explore abandoned biospheres at the bottom of the ocean, alone or with up to 4 friends.
items.title: Subterror

items.description: To save money, you rent an unusually cheap apartment, believing you could coexist with “them” as you always have. But you soon discover that the disturbances here run far deeper—and are far more dangerous—than anything you’ve encountered before.
items.description_ja: あなたは生まれつき霊的感知能力を持つ青年。節約のため、異様に安いアパートを借りることにした。これまでのように「彼ら」と平和に共存できると思っていたが、ここで起こる異変はこれまでよりも深く、そして危険だった…
items.title: Haunted Room : 205

items.description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.
items.description_ja: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.
items.title: Wasteland Bites

items.description: IT HAS YOUR FACE. Now it wants your life. Hide, seek, and try to kill your clone in this deceptively simple first-person horror roguelite.
items.description_ja: 殺される前にクローンを倒せ！このサンドボックス・ホラーゲームで、クローンから隠れて、戦って、狩れ。自分にそっくりなクローンの恐ろしい物語を解き明かそう。
items.title: It Has My Face

items.description: Survive the horrors of hell’s deadest-end job: a human mail clerk. Process occult specimens, sort infernal mail, repair cursed machinery, and survive your shift in a cozy horror workplace simulator.
items.description_ja:
あなたはカリフォルニア州モデストにある「地獄支部」の郵便室で働き始める。
最初はただの単純作業のはずだった――。
だが、やがて常識を揺るがす恐怖があなたを包み込む。

今日も地獄の郵便が届く。
items.title: The Mailroom

items.description: Cyber Detective L solves Paradoxes—bizarre incidents by supernatural Demons—via the social media giant Parrotter. The Cyber Detective Squad, L and his Demon partner Nyasuteria, wield elite hacking and psychic powers to take on the final Paradox investigation.
items.description_ja: 世界最大のSNS「パロッター」から情報を集め怪事件の真相を解明する「ネット探偵」エルは、超能力者〈アクマ〉が引き起こす数々の怪事件〈パラドクス〉を調査してきた。エルは〈アクマ〉の１人である相棒、箱内にゃすてりあと共に、高度なハッキング能力や〈アクマ〉の超能力を駆使して、最後の〈パラドクス〉調査に挑む。
items.title: Demons' Timeline

items.description: this is a game about magnifying horses.
items.description_ja: this is a game about magnifying horses.
items.title: Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse

items.description: Travel back to 16th-century France and delve into the mysterious depths of a seemingly abandoned alchemist's tower. Do you dare brave the horrors that beckon you below... deeper still?
items.description_ja: 16世紀のフランスへとタイムスリップし、廃墟と化した錬金術師の塔の深き謎に挑んでみよう。恐怖に立ち向かい奥へ、さらに奥へと進み行く勇気が果たしてあなたにはあるか？
items.title: Caput Mortum

items.description: No Legs. Just Flips. A hard and punishing game where you flip, fall, and climb as Flippy, using only rotation. Do you have what it takes to get back to Jeff?
items.description_ja: 足はない。フリップだけ。Flippyとなり、回転だけを使ってフリップし、落下し、相棒のもとへ戻るために登り続ける、難しく容赦のないゲーム。
items.title: Flipping is Hard

items.description: Iron Blight is a survival horror game set in a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town. You are trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows, and above all, find your wife, Valeria.
items.description_ja: 『Iron Blight』は冷たい雨が降る旧東側諸国の町を舞台にしたサバイバルホラー。逃げ場のない部屋で異形がドアを掻きむしるなか、熱病のような夜を生き延び、暗闇の恐怖を暴き、妻のヴァレリアを見つけ出せ。
items.title: Iron Blight

items.description: Meet silly seals, eat fibsh, swim, and relax!
items.description_ja: おもろいアザラシに出会ったり、フィッシュを食べたり、リラックスしたりしよう！
items.title: Seal World

items.description: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.
items.description_ja: ジョン・グリープは、小さな宇宙人。しかし抱えている問題はとてつもなく大きい。 経営するカジノは大失敗、しかも宇宙マフィアに銀河ひとつ分の借金をしている。解決策は？ 惑星から惑星へ飛び回り、住民たちをさらうことで客を増やし、借金を返済し、そして破綻した結婚生活を立て直すこと。これが何でもありの銀河規模のアクション × ローグライクゲームの組み合わせ！
items.title: JOHN GLEEP

items.description: DISCOPUP is a mystery game about a seal who wants to sneak inside a dogs-only party. Explore the city and meet shady characters as your search for the perfect dog costume.
items.description_ja: DISCOPUP is a mystery game about a seal who wants to sneak inside a dogs-only party. Explore the city and meet shady characters as your search for the perfect dog costume.
items.title: DISCOPUP

items.description: The silent union of two girls begins to dissolve in an abandoned high school. A melancholic and liminal short story played in a single sitting, where the fear of collapse is felt at every moment.
items.description_ja: 廃校を舞台に、二人の少女の絆が解け始める。崩壊への恐怖が常に漂う、一度のプレイで完結する、メランコリックでリミナルな短編ストーリー。
items.title: Dissolution of the Silent Union

items.description:
Sinner Maker allows you to create characters and simulate a society built around them. Construct homes, manage their needs, and watch as they fall in love, form friendships, and even become enemies.
Manage resources and solve emerging problems if you want your soul to be saved.
items.description_ja:
Sinner Maker allows you to create characters and simulate a society built around them. Construct homes, manage their needs, and watch as they fall in love, form friendships, and even become enemies.
Manage resources and solve emerging problems if you want your soul to be saved.
items.title: Sinner Maker

items.description:
With sudden powers, meet 6 unique girls in an extraordinary campus romance.
Campus beauty, teacher, maiden, or girl next door... sweet or dangerous, all have secrets.
Don't Blush is a 1st-person FMV romance where your choices shape everyone's fate.
Beyond boundaries, beyond mere sparks.
items.description_ja:
With sudden powers, meet 6 unique girls in an extraordinary campus romance.
Campus beauty, teacher, maiden, or girl next door... sweet or dangerous, all have secrets.
Don't Blush is a 1st-person FMV romance where your choices shape everyone's fate.
Beyond boundaries, beyond mere sparks.
items.title: 不心动才有鬼

items.description: Grenouilles 3D is a multiplayer co-hopping game. Hop your way out of polluted ponds and try to find a more suitable place to live. With a unique mouse only control scheme, alone or with your colorful friends hop to the top!
items.description_ja: Grenouilles 3D is a multiplayer co-hopping game. Hop your way out of polluted ponds and try to find a more suitable place to live. With a unique mouse only control scheme, alone or with your colorful friends hop to the top!
items.title: Grenouilles 3D

items.description: First-person psychological horror where the elevator is the only safe place. Each floor is a new reality. Each floor has a new inhabitant. Find it to continue your descent downward.
items.description_ja: エレベーターだけが安全な場所という一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー。各フロアは新しい現実。各フロアには新しい住人がいる。下への降下を続けるためにそれを見つけ出せ。
items.title: Psalm 2

items.description: How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.
items.description_ja: How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.
items.title: Don't Sleep With The Fishes

items.description:
A cute incremental game packed with dopamine!
Just hover. Stab forks into giant fruit for gold, buy more forks, and pick Boons that stack into big synergies. Smash the fruit into jam and spend it on powerful skills!
items.description_ja:
ドーパミンがはじける、かわいいインクリメンタルゲーム！
カーソルを合わせるだけ。巨大なフルーツにフォークを突き刺してゴールドを稼ぎ、フォークを買い集め、秘伝を選んでシナジーを完成させましょう。フルーツを砕いて集めたジャムで、強力なスキルを習得できます！
items.title: Stick A Fork

items.description: Captain Wayne is an intense, fast-action Retro Shooter about a sailor with a SHOTGUN for an ARM!! With a cartoony, hand-drawn art style and gory gameplay, you'll have to mow down enemies through 8 action-packed locales to take back what's yours. ARE YOU READY TO RAISE ANCHOR?
items.description_ja: Captain Wayneは、片腕がショットガンになっている水兵が主人公のハードで高速アクションのレトロシューティングゲームだ！！漫画のような手書きのアートスタイルとゴアなゲームプレイでアクション満載の8つの舞台で敵を皆殺しにし、奪われたものを取り返さなければならない。錨を揚げる準備はいいか？
items.title: Captain Wayne - Vacation Desperation

items.description: No Fair Play is a physics-based multiplayer game that combines parkour, combat, and football mechanics to offer great freedom to players.
items.description_ja: "No Fair Play"は、物理をベースにしたマルチプレイヤーゲームで、パルクール、戦闘、サッカーのメカニックを組み合わせ、プレイヤーに大きな自由度を提供します。
items.title: No Fair Play

items.description: TROLEU is a wacky and chaotic first-person action game that puts you in the shoes of a trolleybus conductor. Keep things rolling smoothly by ensuring passengers' travel validity, but watch out for rule-breakers! From issuing tickets to enforcing rules with your fists, it's all part of the wild ride.
items.description_ja: 『TROLEU』はカオスでぶっ飛んだ1人称視点のアクションゲーム。トロリーバスの車掌となってスムーズにバスを運行させよう！不正乗車をしようとする客もいるぞ！発券も非常識な乗客をぶちのめすのも車掌の立派な仕事。交通機関の安全を守るため、ワイルドに職務をまっとうしよう。
items.title: TROLEU

items.description: In this mascot horror game, you explore an abandoned children’s asylum and solve deceptive puzzles with your plush squid gun. Escape Chompy Chasey, befriend (or avoid) Binky Drinky, and uncover secrets you had long forgotten about. Do you remember?
items.description_ja: 放棄された児童精神療養施設が舞台の、シングルプレイヤー用マスコットホラーゲーム。「インクブラスター」で周囲環境のパズルを解き、キケンなマスコットたちから逃げ、ずっと昔に忘れてしまった秘密を明かそう。思い出したかな？
items.title: Dark Pals: The 1st Floor

items.description: Learn 1,000+ words and phrases in 12 languages - including Japanese & Spanish - with no subscription and no ads. Explore a colorful open world, beat vocab mini-games, and speak to NPCs using real speech recognition. Language learning that actually sticks, and actually feels like a game.
items.description_ja: 12言語で1,000以上の単語やフレーズを学ぼう — サブスクなし、広告なし。カラフルなオープンワールドを探索し、語彙ミニゲームをクリアして、本物の音声認識でNPCと会話しよう。本当に身につく、本当にゲームらしい語学学習。
items.title: Noun Town Language Learning

items.description: A short narrative-driven psychological horror game about a trainee metro driver trapped in the dampest subway east of anything that matters.
items.description_ja: 重要なものすべての東にある最も湿った地下鉄に閉じ込められた研修中の地下鉄運転士を描く、短編のナラティブ重視の心理ホラーゲームです。
items.title: Brno Transit

items.description: In this mind-blowing insane-arcade RPG, Jennyfer takes down "The Organization" and summons The Legendary Devourer of Dead in order to wipe the planet.
items.description_ja: In this mind-blowing insane-arcade RPG, Jennyfer takes down "The Organization" and summons The Legendary Devourer of Dead in order to wipe the planet.
items.title: Bad Bitch Blasters

items.description: You open your eyes in a dark, unfamiliar room; each door drags you into a new chamber filled with absurd surprises and dark comedy. Will you manage to escape, or will you continue to star in this black comedy?
items.description_ja: 目を覚ますと、暗くて見覚えのない部屋にいる。扉を開けるたびに、突飛な驚きとブラックコメディに満ちた新たな部屋へ引きずり込まれる。逃げ出すことはできるだろうか、それともこのブラックコメディの主役であり続けるのだろうか？
items.title: Scary Game

items.description: HOLY GRAIL for DUMMIES is a colorful and absurd action-platformer about Buckethead, a hero past his prime, in a world that, let's be honest, has seen better days...
items.description_ja: HOLY GRAIL for DUMMIES is a colorful and absurd action-platformer about Buckethead, a hero past his prime, in a world that, let's be honest, has seen better days...
items.title: HOLY GRAIL for DUMMIES

items.description: Escaped from Liam's obsession, Kate seeks refuge in her grandpa's mansion. Strange occurrences raise questions about Liam's presence or another figure. Unraveling mysterious letters, Kate embarks on a journey, seeking peace.
items.description_ja: Escaped from Liam's obsession, Kate seeks refuge in her grandpa's mansion. Strange occurrences raise questions about Liam's presence or another figure. Unraveling mysterious letters, Kate embarks on a journey, seeking peace.
items.title: The Stalked

items.description: A 1 to 4 player Y2K dream-exploration game. Free your imaginary friends trapped to eternal sleep by the goddess Mama. Collect cursed items and use weapons to face the monsters in Mama's dreams.
items.description_ja: これは1～4人で遊べるY2K夢探索ゲーム。女神「ママ」によって永遠の眠りについた忘れ去られた魂たちを解放しよう。祝福もしくは滅亡をもたらす数々の呪われたアイテムを集め、武器を使ってママの夢の中に潜む怪物たちに立ち向かおう。
items.title: Mama's Sleeping Angels

items.description: Fight, Scavenge, Survive, and File Your Taxes. A grim yet hilarious space strategy roguelite where you must balance hull integrity against your company's relentless profit margins. Warning: Contains lethal doses of dark humor and corporate exploitation.
items.description_ja: 『銀河の暗い隅』は星間業務をテーマにした宇宙ストラテジー・ローグライク。艦隊を率いて任務を受注し、戦闘やイベントを経て資材を回収、モジュール改造で戦力を雪だるま式に強化せよ。不利な時は撤退するのも戦術だが、艦隊の損耗やペナルティは容赦なく清算書に記録される。この銀河の暗い隅では、生きて帰ることにすらコストがかかるのだ！
items.title: Nonentity Galaxy

items.description: Your house needs a deck. You have a hammer. Freedom is $1,000,000.
items.description_ja: Your house needs a deck. You have a hammer. Freedom is $1,000,000.
items.title: ROGUE LIGHT DECK BUILDER

items.description: Cellar Keeper is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort 2,448 scattered bottles throughout a forgotten cellar. Return every bottle to its proper shelf, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.
items.description_ja: 『Cellar Keeper』は、忘れられた地下貯蔵庫に散らばった2,448本のボトルを整理する、心安らぐシングルプレイ整理シミュレーションです。すべてのボトルを正しい棚へ戻し、種類ごとにコレクションを完成させ、便利なスキルをアンロックしながら、美しい秩序を取り戻しましょう。
items.title: Cellar Keeper

items.description: The year is 1998. Step into the shoes of a real estate agent, tasked with photographing a seemingly ordinary house for an upcoming sale. Explore the environment, use your camera to take pictur-- wait, what’s that in the last photo?
items.description_ja: 1998年です。不動産業者の役になり、今後の販売のために一見普通の家を撮影する仕事をしてください。環境を探索し、カメラを使って写真を撮る--- ちょっと待って、最後の写真に何かある？
items.title: For Sale

items.description: Congratulations, contractor! You've been approved to trial our cutting-edge AI visor. Use it to explore the Neuras lab and recover the staff's research. Your visor is safe, reliable, and up to 99% accurate. Just don't ask why the "ketchup" in the corner makes such a horrible crunching sound.
items.description_ja: Congratulations, contractor! You've been approved to trial our cutting-edge AI visor. Use it to explore the Neuras lab and recover the staff's research. Your visor is safe, reliable, and up to 99% accurate. Just don't ask why the "ketchup" in the corner makes such a horrible crunching sound.
items.title: PROXIMATE

items.description: Penguin Helper is your chance to go to the South Pole, become a hero for penguins and enjoy a peaceful atmosphere
items.description_ja: Penguin Helperは、南極に行って、ペンギンのヒーローになり、平和な雰囲気を楽しむチャンスです。
items.title: Penguin Helper

items.description:
"Let's play together… forever, okay?"
Menherarium is a deck-building roguelite where you survive 7 days of blood-staked Chinchiro against a clingy menhera girl. Trapped and forced to gamble your blood daily in twisted dice games, use cheat items and overcome her changing rules to survive.
items.description_ja:
「私と死ぬまで遊んでよ♡」『メンヘラリウム』は、超メンヘラな女の子(CV:夏吉ゆうこ)に血を賭けたチンチロで勝ち続ける、デッキ構築ローグライトゲームです。
あなたは超メンヘラな女の子に監禁され、血を賭けたチンチロを毎日行わなければいけません。 彼女から突き付けられる理不尽なルールを、出目を改造したりイカサマアイテムを使って突破し7日間を生き延びましょう。
items.title: Menherarium: Deadly Dice

items.description: Coconut Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a coconut.
items.description_ja: Coconut Simulator 2は、あなたがココナッツになれるゲームです。
items.title: Coconut Simulator 2

items.description: [97% Very Positive] Teamwork has never been this chaotic! Throw your head, transform into one, and maybe... kick your friend's head across the map in this physics-based platformer? Team up for hilarious cyber adventures, or tackle the madness solo!
items.description_ja: 【97%高評価】頭を投げ出して、頭に変身して、または仲間の頭をサッカーボールのように蹴り飛ばす。プラットフォームアクションとおバカな物理演算シミュレーションが融合した本作で、友達と一緒にドタバタ騒ぎのサイバー冒険へ繰り出そう。（本作はシングルプレイにも対応しています）
items.title: Head's Adventures:chibichibi

items.description: A self abating husk is forcibly coerced into a suicide pact by a "perfect" girl drowning in ennui and despair. The result is unfathomable heart rending terror and confusion.
items.description_ja: A self abating husk is forcibly coerced into a suicide pact by a "perfect" girl drowning in ennui and despair. The result is unfathomable heart rending terror and confusion.
items.title: PASSENGER x PRINCESS: NO HOPE // MUST DIE

items.description: A grim RPG with card-based combat where nothing stays dead. Lead a party of survivors through a world undone by shattered Laws. Restore them and reshape the rules of the game, but be ready to face the consequences.
items.description_ja: カードベースの戦闘を採用したダークRPG。そこでは、死したものが永遠に死んだままでいることはない。砕かれた「法則」によって崩壊した世界で、生存者たちの一団を率いよ。それらを取り戻し、ゲームのルールそのものを作り変えよ――ただし、その代償を受け入れる覚悟を持て。
items.title: Shards of Order

items.description: BLOOD MALL: RETAPED is a short first-person dinosaur horror game inspired by creature features of the 80s, and the works of Puppet Combo. Take control of a big game hunter-turned-rookie cop, sent to deal with a prehistoric threat that has turned the Dayton County Mall into a blood-soaked hell.
items.description_ja: BLOOD MALL: RETAPED is a short first-person dinosaur horror game inspired by creature features of the 80s, and the works of Puppet Combo. Take control of a big game hunter-turned-rookie cop, sent to deal with a prehistoric threat that has turned the Dayton County Mall into a blood-soaked hell.
items.title: BLOOD MALL: RETAPED

items.description: Collect units and build powerful synergies on a restricted grid in Hell Deck, a dark roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Construct your own bizarre, twisted ecosystem through a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, and defend hell from the holy swarm
items.description_ja: Collect units and build powerful synergies on a restricted grid in Hell Deck, a dark roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Construct your own bizarre, twisted ecosystem through a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, and defend hell from the holy swarm
items.title: Hell Deck

items.description: "Let's play a typing game." Dyping Escape is a simple game where you type according to instructions from the game master, a mysterious eyeball. But be careful; everything you type becomes reality. Just be careful not to brick your computer.
items.description_ja: 「あなたに是非タイピングゲームをして欲しいのです。」『Dyping Escape』は、ゲームマスターである”目玉”の指示に従い、キーを打つだけのタイピングゲームです。ただし、入力した言葉はそのままあなたの身に降りかかります。自ら不可解なプログラムを入力してPCを壊したりしないようご注意ください。
items.title: Dyping Escape

items.description: Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories.
items.description_ja: ペンギンの視点で体験するコズミックホラー。対立する派閥に属する人間たちが、ペンギンたちの故郷である南極へやって来た。この世のものとは思えない古の存在を探し求めて——H.P.ラヴクラフトの『狂気の山脈にて』などの物語を忠実に再解釈した世界で、人々が狂気に堕ちていく姿を見届けよ。
items.title: Penguin Colony

items.description: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.
items.description_ja: 『鬼子母 Hariti』は、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラーゲームです。プレイヤーは一人の母親となり、危機の迫る病院の中で行方不明の娘を捜索します。廃墟となった中国式の病院で、極限の恐怖と重苦しい雰囲気を体験することになります。
items.title: Hariti

items.description: An explosive mix of action and mystery, seasoned with black humor and a sinister atmosphere.  Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?
items.description_ja: アクションとミステリーが爆発的にミックスされ、ブラックユーモアと不吉な雰囲気で味付けされています。 勇敢な少年ブリジーと共に地獄を旅し、悪のを倒しましょう。世界を救い、ヒーローになるのでしょう。しかし、そこには代償があります。
items.title: Creepy Tale: Snow Child

items.description: Trench Face is a horror turn based war RPG featuring exploration-based dungeons, with hanging monsters lurking around each corner. Every enemy varying in strengths and weaknesses. Escape the trench with your life.
items.description_ja: Trench Face is a horror turn based war RPG featuring exploration-based dungeons, with hanging monsters lurking around each corner. Every enemy varying in strengths and weaknesses. Escape the trench with your life.
items.title: Trench Face

items.description: An anime android maid and her work drone are meeting a quota at the warehouse! A simple yet engaging game about the monotonous, relaxing process of working as a mover. Short but challenging levels, multiplayer, and lots and lots of boxes await you!
items.description_ja: アニメのアンドロイドメイドと彼女の作業ドローンが倉庫でノルマを達成中！運送業者として働く単調でリラックスできるプロセスについての、シンプルだけど魅力的なゲーム。短くてもやりがいのあるレベル、マルチプレイヤー、そしてたくさんの箱があなたを待っています！
items.title: MAID MOVING BOXES

items.description: Skin Off is an analog horror game where you play as a teenager spending a summer night alone at your uncle’s house. As you wait for your friends to arrive the next day, a strange message is broadcasted on national television, signaling the start of a nightmare you can’t escape.
items.description_ja: Skin Off is an analog horror game where you play as a teenager spending a summer night alone at your uncle’s house. As you wait for your friends to arrive the next day, a strange message is broadcasted on national television, signaling the start of a nightmare you can’t escape.
items.title: Analog - Skin off

items.description: Safely escort the intoxicated person to her couch at home.
items.description_ja: 泥酔者を無事に自宅のソファーまで送り届けましょう。
items.title: Momoka (wo) Wasshoi

items.description: Work together to survive the night shift in this challenging co-op PvE horror game. Serve your villagers as disgraced knights by evading danger to fulfill their commands in this cursed kingdom. Reclaim your lost honor to earn your place on the watch. How long can you survive?
items.description_ja: Work together to survive the night shift in this challenging co-op PvE horror game. Serve your villagers as disgraced knights by evading danger to fulfill their commands in this cursed kingdom. Reclaim your lost honor to earn your place on the watch. How long can you survive?
items.title: Knights End

items.description: This is a Ghost is an FPS psychological horror and investigation game for 1 to 4 players. Track down supernatural activity, identify demonic entities using specialised equipment, and banish them with crafted ammunition in solo or online co-op!
items.description_ja: 『This is a Ghost』は、1〜4人向けのFPS心理的ホラー＆調査ゲームです。超常現象を追跡し、専門装備を使って悪魔的実体を特定し、クラフトした弾薬でソロまたはオンライン協力プレイで除霊しましょう！
items.title: This is a Ghost

items.description:
A short horror- I mean, cute game :)
Help a normal, innocent frog get back to his super awesome wizard self!! :O
items.description_ja:
A short horror- I mean, cute game :)
Help a normal, innocent frog get back to his super awesome wizard self!! :O
items.title: I Frog-ot

items.description: A team based PVP game where groups of up to 8 players must work together to operate a tank!
items.description_ja: A team based PVP game where groups of up to 8 players must work together to operate a tank!
items.title: Tank Team

items.description: Cook traditional 19th-century Italian recipes in a kitchen haunted by hunger. A short psychological horror where gastronomy, ritual and cosmic appetite share the same table.
items.description_ja: 19世紀イタリアの伝統料理を調理。飢餓に取り憑かれた厨房で。美食、儀式、宇宙的食欲が食卓で一堂に会す短編サイコロジカルホラー。
items.title: Cucina Stellata

items.description: “Worthy or Not” is an FMV about Dating Agency. Players make choices across diverse in-game topics, which modify target characters’ latent attributes. The final matchmaking phase, based on accumulated latent value changes, unlocks multiple endings. You play as a matchmaking agency owner faced girls
items.description_ja: “Worthy or Not” is an FMV about Dating Agency. Players make choices across diverse in-game topics, which modify target characters’ latent attributes. The final matchmaking phase, based on accumulated latent value changes, unlocks multiple endings. You play as a matchmaking agency owner faced girls
items.title: Worthy or Not

items.description: Among Ashes is a terrifying first-person survival horror game. Your friend has sent you a link to a game that someone posted online, but as you play you quickly realise that something is terribly wrong. Whatever you do… K̴͉͚̗̅̃̄E̷͓̤̺̊͠E̴̤̰̿̽P̴̠̳̀́ ̴̨̮̭̕̚P̷̠͇̳͐̓̀L̶̹̔Ả̷̧Y̵̘̺͆̓Ï̸̻̏͂N̷͙̯͊G̵͖̹̠̽̿
items.description_ja: Among Ashes』は恐ろしい一人称視点のサバイバルホラーゲームだ。友人からオンラインに投稿されたゲームへのリンクが送られてきたが、プレイしているうちに何かがひどく間違っていることにすぐに気づく。何をするにしても... プレイを続けよう。
items.title: Among Ashes

items.description: An absurd personality testing experience with a whole lot of questions for you.
items.description_ja: An absurd personality testing experience with a whole lot of questions for you.
items.title: Foole's World

items.description:
You are a bird. You have a nest. Other birds want your eggs.

Birds of War is a team-based aerial PvP game. Raid nests, steal eggs, fight beak-to-beak in fast, chaotic matches built around flight and combat.

Your mic is always hot. Your enemies can hear you. Plan accordingly.
items.description_ja:
あなたは鳥。巣がある。他の鳥はあなたの卵を狙っている。

Birds of War はチーム制の空中PvPゲーム。巣を襲い、卵を奪い、くちばし同士で戦う、飛行と戦闘を軸にした高速でカオスなマッチ。

マイクは常にオン。敵には聞こえている。覚悟して動け。
items.title: Birds of War

items.description: In this presidential rogue-like action game, gather votes and run for presidency by day, then transform into a warrior to take down your enemies by night! Master unique skills to become a swordmaster, a cyber mage, or anything in between, and overthrow the ruthless president!
items.description_ja: 本作はアクション系ローグライクゲーム。君は邪悪な現職大統領に挑む！昼は基地を建設し支持票を集め、夜はスーツのアウトローとして敵地に潜入し、犯罪組織を壊滅させ、ふわふわの生物を救え。数十種類の異能と武器を自由に組み合わせ、変化に富んだステージで自分だけのビルドを構築しよう！
items.title: Anomaly President

items.description: KUNKUN Defender 2 is a hybrid TPS and tower defense game where players must fend off waves of zombies in virus-infected zones, holding their ground until a helicopter arrives for extraction.
items.description_ja: 『KUNKUNディフェンダー2』は、TPSとタワーディフェンスを融合させたハイブリッドゲームです。プレイヤーはウイルスに感染したゾーンでゾンビの波を食い止め、ヘリコプターが救出に来るまで持ちこたえなければなりません。
items.title: KUNKUN Defender 2

items.description: You're trapped in an old English pub. Unravel a chilling tale by identifying anomalies while trying to escape. Confront the horror as you survive the endless loop of Ten Bells.
items.description_ja: 古いイングリッシュパブに閉じ込められている。脱出を試みながら異常を発見し、ぞっとする物語を解き明かせ。終わりのないループに生き残りながら恐怖に立ち向かえ、「ザ・テンベルズ」の無限ループを生き延びろ。
items.title: Ten Bells

items.description: A short folk horror story about the Scottish witch trials. You play the role of a witch finder. Speak to the locals and sort their truths from their lies. On the last morning a witch must hang, best you know who by then.
items.description_ja: スコットランドの魔女裁判がテーマの短編ホラー。あなたは魔女を突き止める役となり、地元の人々から話を聞き、嘘か真実かを見極めなければならない。最終日の朝、魔女が処刑されるまでに答えを出せ。
items.title: Daemonologie

items.description: Without a Dawn is a dark, psychological, and philosophical visual horror novel featuring hauntingly beautiful pseudo-ASCII art.
items.description_ja: Without a Dawn は心に染み入る美しさを持ったアスキーアート風の映像を特徴とする、暗く心理的かつ哲学的なビジュアルホラーノベル。
items.title: Without a Dawn

items.description: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 is the final chapter of the psychological thriller trilogy. With point-and-click mechanics, intricate puzzles, and cinematic cutscenes, immerse yourself in a dark horror experience that redefines the genre.
items.description_ja: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 is the final chapter of the psychological thriller trilogy. With point-and-click mechanics, intricate puzzles, and cinematic cutscenes, immerse yourself in a dark horror experience that redefines the genre.
items.title: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3

items.description: Ascend through the twisted levels of the Backrooms using physics-based object manipulation to overcome obstacles, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover unsettling secrets. Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players as you climb higher, think smarter, and survive the unknown.
items.description_ja: Ascend through the twisted levels of the Backrooms using physics-based object manipulation to overcome obstacles, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover unsettling secrets. Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players as you climb higher, think smarter, and survive the unknown.
items.title: Climb The Backrooms

items.description: Descend into Lovecraftian horror aboard a claustrophobic military submarine. Assign tasks as a captain’s right hand, analyze sonar signals, make hard decisions, and keep the crew from madness. Dark horrors lurk both within… and beyond the hull.
items.description_ja: 閉塞感漂う軍用潜水艦でラヴクラフト的ホラーに降り立つ。艦長の右腕として任務を割り当て、ソナー信号を解析し、過酷な決断を下し、乗組員を狂気から守れ。暗い恐怖は内部にも…船体外にも潜む。
items.title: Static Dread: The Submarine

items.description: Run your bar as a gorilla and hunt down the humans in animal costumes hiding among your customers. Observe them closely, spot the clues that give their disguises away, test their slogans, and blow the imposters away with your shotgun. Choose your targets wisely... or become the hunted.
items.description_ja: ゴリラとしてバーを経営し、客の中に紛れた動物の着ぐるみを着た人間を狩れ。注意深く観察し、変装を見破る手がかりを見つけ、スローガンを試し、ショットガンでインポスターを排除せよ。賢く標的を選べ…さもなくば狩られる側になる。
items.title: Animaly Bar: NO HUMANITY!

items.description: Equipped only with a weapon that consumes your own blood, explore an ancient brutalist catacomb. Beware the Eyes of The Whispering Crypt. Find the 4 artifacts of desire. Confront God.
items.description_ja: Equipped only with a weapon that consumes your own blood, explore an ancient brutalist catacomb. Beware the Eyes of The Whispering Crypt. Find the 4 artifacts of desire. Confront God.
items.title: CONCRETE BURIAL

items.description: Sheriff James Cooper is slowly bleeding to death in an unfamiliar hospital. But the moment his life ends, everything starts over. He has fifteen minutes to break this endless cycle, uncover the truth, and find a way out before it's too late.
items.description_ja: ジェームズ・クーパー警長は見知らぬ病院で出血しながらゆっくりと死んでいきます。しかし、彼の命が絶たれるたびにすべてが再び始まります。彼には15分の時間があり、この無限ループを断ち切り、真実を明らかにし、出口を見つけなければなりません。時間がなくなる前に。
items.title: Fear The Timeloop

items.description: Singleplayer psychological horror game about bird watching. Explore the mountains, find and observe all the birds. Seek their help. Be honest. Be ruthless. They are watching.
items.description_ja: あなたは地球上で最後の人類です。毎日、鳥を観察して過ごしています。山には、あなた以外にも何かがいます。
items.title: Birds Watching

items.description: A city under curfew. A killer on the loose. You’re a delivery driver racing to finish your last run before 9 PM in a decaying apartment complex where every knock could be your last, in this PSX-style psychological horror.
items.description_ja: A city under curfew. A killer on the loose. You’re a delivery driver racing to finish your last run before 9 PM in a decaying apartment complex where every knock could be your last, in this PSX-style psychological horror.
items.title: Jaden Williams' The Stalking Stairs

items.description: Golf Gang is a racing game. It’s a party game. It’s the fastest game of minigolf you'll ever play!  Blend precision with speed to dominate in 8-player online mayhem or your solo speed runs.
items.description_ja: Golf Gangはレーシング ゲームとパーティー ゲームの要素を持つ、今までにないスピードのミニゴルフ ゲームです！最大8人のマルチ プレイやソロ プレイ モードで、正確かつ速いプレイで勝利をつかみましょう。
items.title: Golf Gang

items.description: As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?
items.description_ja: 謎の組織の従業員であるあなたの仕事は、監視カメラの映像を監視し、鋭い観察眼と優れた記憶力を駆使して異世界の異常を報告することです。夜勤を乗り切れるでしょうか？それとも疑心暗鬼に陥るのでしょうか？
items.title: I'm on Observation Duty 8

items.description: Colin’s apartment maze has puzzles, dialogues, and some dry humor waiting for you. A surreal adventure of a special kind.
items.description_ja: コリンのアパートの迷宮には、パズル、対話、そして少しのドライなユーモアがあなたを待っています。特別な種類の超現実的な冒険です。
items.title: Mindlock - The Apartment

items.description: Dreadline Express is a 1st-person, psychological horror metroidbrainia set aboard the last human train. Unravel mysteries of the enigmatic train, face strange passengers, and shape your path using a unique card-based mechanic that gives you full narrative control. This is no longer our world.
items.description_ja: Dreadline Express は、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー・メトロイドブレイニアであり、最後の人類列車が舞台です。謎めいた列車の秘密を解き明かし、奇妙な乗客たちに立ち向かい、ユニークなカードベースのメカニクスを使って物語を自分の手で形作ろう。もはやこれは私たちの世界ではない。
items.title: Dreadline Express

items.description: The train is the only escape.
items.description_ja: The train is the only escape.
items.title: Welcome To The Dark Place

items.description: An investigation of a secret film studio underneath their school has led 3 students down an estranged rabbit hole. With the fixed-camera as your weapon, shine a light on the truth and save your friends.
items.description_ja: An investigation of a secret film studio underneath their school has led 3 students down an estranged rabbit hole. With the fixed-camera as your weapon, shine a light on the truth and save your friends.
items.title: Studio System : Guardian Angel

items.description:
Manipulate climate, add plants and evolve creatures in this planet and life sandbox simulation game. 
From cells to civilizations, spread life throughout the whole planet. 
Or just enjoy watching your creation burn!
items.description_ja:
この惑星と生命のサンドボックスシミュレーションゲームで、気候を操作し、植物を追加し、生き物を進化させよう。
細胞から文明まで、惑星全体に生命を広げよう。
あるいは、自分の創造物が燃え尽きるのを眺めて楽しむこともできる！
items.title: Planetary Life

items.description:
A short visual novel presented with pixel art and cute animations. 
Chasing after a rabbit, Alice found herself in a land of talking plants. 
Now, it's time to go on a tiny little adventure.
items.description_ja:
ピクセルアートとアニメーションで描かれる短編ビジュアルノベル。
ウサギを追ってアリスが迷い込んだのは、喋る植物たちの国でした。
さあ、アリスと一緒に小さな小さな冒険の旅へ。
items.title: Slay the Alice

items.description: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)
items.description_ja: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)
items.title: Funi Raccoon Game

items.description: “SHE WAS 98” - you play as a grandson who returns to his elderly grandmother's home to care for her.....
items.description_ja: “SHE WAS 98” - you play as a grandson who returns to his elderly grandmother's home to care for her.....
items.title: SHE WAS 98

items.description: A single-player incremental game where you rip open boosters and complete the ultimate card collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear, and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Fill every page in a satisfying 3-5 hour session. Your binder is waiting!
items.description_ja: パックを開封して究極のカードコレクションを完成させる、シングルプレイのインクリメンタルゲーム。ダブりを売り、装備をアップグレードし、セットアップを自動化して、より多くのカードをより速く引き当てろ！3〜5時間の爽快なプレイで、すべてのページを埋め尽くせ。バインダーが待っているぞ！
items.title: Rip It! Card Collector

items.description: Step into the frozen unknown in Forsaken Frontiers, a cooperative analog horror adventure set in the unforgiving embrace of an everlasting winter.
items.description_ja: Step into the frozen unknown in Forsaken Frontiers, a cooperative analog horror adventure set in the unforgiving embrace of an everlasting winter.
items.title: Forsaken Frontiers

items.description: A dark lesbian horror/romance story so toxic it's emitting spores. Ethel, a shy university student, ventures into the wintry woods late at night, where she meets an enchanting femme fatale — but all is not as it seems.
items.description_ja: A dark lesbian horror/romance story so toxic it's emitting spores. Ethel, a shy university student, ventures into the wintry woods late at night, where she meets an enchanting femme fatale — but all is not as it seems.
items.title: Her Love, Like Poison

items.description: A story about an unemployed girl named Luna, who wanted to buy her favorite figure so much that she had to get a job.
items.description_ja: 失業中の少女ルナが大好きなフィギュアをどうしても欲しくて仕事探しせざるを得なくなるお話。
items.title: MAHOUTEQ!

items.description: All Hail The Orb is a short, quirky pixel-art incremental game about powering a mysterious orb, summoning cultists, exploring a dungeon and slowly unlocking automation as devotion builds. The tone is light-hearted and a little silly with no fail states, relaxed pacing, and yes...many, many ducks.
items.description_ja: All Hail The Orb is a short, quirky pixel-art incremental game about powering a mysterious orb, summoning cultists, exploring a dungeon and slowly unlocking automation as devotion builds. The tone is light-hearted and a little silly with no fail states, relaxed pacing, and yes...many, many ducks.
items.title: All Hail the Orb

items.description: Black Hole Fishing is an absurd incremental game about catching, breeding, and perfecting SO MANY fish. Catch a fish, optimize its traits, then stock your pond with it as you pour fish and science into an endless singularity!
items.description_ja: リラックスできる釣り旅行なんて忘れましょう、あなたは惑星破壊を最適化しているのです。突飛な実験を行い、奇妙な魚を繁殖させ、成長するシンギュラリティに食べさせましょう。科学が行き過ぎた、魅力的でダークコメディ調のインクリメンタルゲームです。
items.title: Black Hole Fishing

items.description: Love, Death & My Daughter is a free game that combines a virtual desktop interface with narrative storytelling. you will repair a memory program within an old software system, gradually recover memories from the past, and come to understand the love a mother left behind in a new light.
items.description_ja: 『愛と死と、私の娘』は、無料で遊べる短編のピクセルアート・ナラティブゲームです。雨の墓地を歩き、不具合を修復し、記憶と記録をたどってください。かすかな恐怖と歪みの中で、ひとりの母親が遺した愛を知る物語です。
items.title: Love, Death & My Daughter

items.description: Onion Voting Simulator 3D is an action-packed walking sim where you perform America's most taboo act: Voting. It’s Election Day and your choice could change the country's fate! But it won’t be easy: Resist the allure of staying home! Explore a school gym! And don’t get lost, because Hell is real!
items.description_ja: Onion Voting Simulator 3D is an action-packed walking sim where you perform America's most taboo act: Voting. It’s Election Day and your choice could change the country's fate! But it won’t be easy: Resist the allure of staying home! Explore a school gym! And don’t get lost, because Hell is real!
items.title: The Onion Voting Simulator 3D

items.description:
Ignited Entry is a full length narrative driven psychological horror game with voice acting, dreamish visuals, and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 

Some doors should never be opened. But you must go in.
items.description_ja:
Ignited Entry is a full length narrative driven psychological horror game with voice acting, dreamish visuals, and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 

Some doors should never be opened. But you must go in.
items.title: Ignited Entry

items.description:
Village romance hotter than summer's heat!

Drowning in debt, you escape to the countryside
only to meet the loan shark noona, your first love, and the tsundere village princess!

This summer, your heart’s melting faster than ice cream.
Who’s going to set your world on fire?
items.description_ja:
真夏より熱い田舎ロマンスが始まる！
借金に追われ、故郷の田舎へ戻ってきたあなた。
そこに現れるのは、あなたを追ってきた闇金のお姉さん、忘れられない初恋の相手、そしてツンデレな村長の娘！
アイスより先に心が溶けそうなこの夏、あなたが選ぶ恋は誰？
items.title: Summer’s Heartbeat

items.description: Lively Chair Simulator is an indie multiplayer game with strange controls. Let’s see if you are suitable to be a chair.
items.description_ja: Lively Chair Simulatorは、奇妙な操作性を持つインディーズマルチプレイヤーゲームです。あなたが椅子になれるか試してみよう！
items.title: Lively Chair Simulator

items.description: Trapped in what appears to be an endless hallway in your home, rooms begin to feel unfamiliar. Capture anomalies on camera and stay away from any sinister entities.
items.description_ja: 家の中の終わりのない廊下に閉じ込められ、部屋が次第に見慣れないものに感じられてくる。違いを見つけ、異常現象を記録し、邪悪な存在から離れていよう。
items.title: CAPTURED

items.description: Want to grab cute Taffies and toss them around? Dilly-draggy Taffy Town is a casual town-building fan game inspired by indie VTuber Ace Taffy. No one-way doors, complex Metroidvania maps or tough bosses—just loads of Taffies to drag around with your big, merciless hands!
items.description_ja: かわいいタフィーをつかんで、ぶんぶん振り回してみませんか？『だらドラタフィタウン』は、個人勢VTuber・永雛タフィーのファンゲーム。気軽に遊べる町づくりシミュレーションです。一方通行の扉も、複雑なメトロイドヴァニア風のマップも、手強いボスもありません。いるのは、そこらじゅうを走り回るたくさんのタフィーたち！あなたは容赦ない大きな手となって、彼女たちをあちこち引っ張り回すだけ！
items.title: 拖拖拉拉小菲镇

items.description: HOPE 01 is a single player extraction survival RPG with multiple endings.  Explore, Loot, and Fight your way through the dangerous enemies and bosses of the hab cluster and solve the mystery of the legendary HAB 01.
items.description_ja:
「HOPE 01」は、複数のエンディングを備えたシングルプレイヤー向けのエクストラクション・サバイバルRPGです。
探索し、物資を集め、戦い抜きながら危険なハブクラスターを進み、伝説の「HAB 01」に秘められた謎を解き明かしましょう。
items.title: HOPE 01

items.description: Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game. Amidst desolate ruins and deserted cities in a world filled with death, the young girl Alice hears "your" voice from in front of the screen. You must guide her forward, solve the mysteries, and reach the top of the tower.
items.description_ja: 『Ib』や『ゆめにっき』に影響を受けた、メタ要素のある謎解きADVです。主人公の少女「アリス」はプレイヤーである「あなた」を認識しています。これはゲームなので、どうプレイするかはあなたの自由です。ただし、アリスもあなたの行いを覚えていることをお忘れなく。
items.title: Alice's World

items.description: Go wild with your BFFS in your ultimate cozy getaway! Yank up hilariously plump veggies, reel in giant flappy fish, bump into adorable little animals, and unlock a bunch of weird and wonderful toys! If you feel like it, doing absolutely nothing on the beach is exactly what you're supposed to do!
items.description_ja: みんななかよく、のんびり島あそび！まるまる巨大野菜を引っこ抜いたり、大きなコイを釣ったり。かわいい動物やヘンテコなおもちゃもいっぱい！気ままに島をおさんぽして、疲れたら砂浜でごろごろ。何もしない時間だって、けっこう大事なんだよね～
items.title: Cozy Island

items.description: Sick of long queues, unfair matchups, and arbitrary reflex tests? Try Q-UP, the coin flipping eSport. It's one part clicker, one part multiplayer strategy game, one part demented capitalism simulator, and 100% completely random.
items.description_ja: Sick of long queues, unfair matchups, and arbitrary reflex tests? Try Q-UP, the coin flipping eSport. It's one part clicker, one part multiplayer strategy game, one part demented capitalism simulator, and 100% completely random.
items.title: Q-UP

items.description: 2006. You become the new reserve caretaker. Patrol the territory in your rugged 4x4, check the phototraps, and monitor the area using surveillance cameras. But remember: you are not the only one watching.
items.description_ja: 2006. あなたは新しい自然保護区の監視員になります。頑丈な四輪駆動車で領地を巡回し、トレイルカメラを確認し、監視カメラを通じて秩序を監視します。ただし、覚えておいてください：あなたは唯一の観察者ではありません。
items.title: Uncanny Tales: The Watcher

items.description: Snap pictures of spooky-cute creatures & explore an abandoned wildlife park.
items.description_ja: チョット不気味…でも、かわいい！ 不思議な生き物たちの写真を撮りながら、廃墟のサファリパークを探検しよう！
items.title: Penko Park

items.description: It's exactly what it sounds like! Have you ever wanted to be a tree? Do you like odd numbers? How about multiplayer, weather, seasons and more!? Well then this is the game for you! Come on down to a place where you will never want to leaf. Relax and be the best tree you can be. 1-250 players.
items.description_ja: It's exactly what it sounds like! Have you ever wanted to be a tree? Do you like odd numbers? How about multiplayer, weather, seasons and more!? Well then this is the game for you! Come on down to a place where you will never want to leaf. Relax and be the best tree you can be. 1-250 players.
items.title: Tree Simulator 2023

items.description: You’re Sophie, a young blind girl who sees through her teddy bear’s eyes. Escape your captors and uncover the evil history of the dark mansion you desperately seek to escape in this unique, atmospheric horror puzzle/adventure game.
items.description_ja: 『Out of Sight』は一人称と二人称視点、そして魅力的な声優の演技をブレンドした、没入感満載のホラーゲーム。背筋が凍るような感情的な旅へとプレイヤーを引き込んでいく。
items.title: Out of Sight

items.description: Get the streamer's attention at any cost before someone else does. Write comments, chat, and make donations to your waifu, but do not dare to hate her!
items.description_ja: ストリーマーの注意をどんな手段を使ってでも勝ち取れ。追い越される前に行動しよう。コミュニケーションをとって、ワイフにドネーションやコメントを送れ。でも絶対に彼女をヘイトするな！
items.title: I Hate My Waifu Streamer

items.description: Experience the psychological horror of being kidnapped by a serial killer. Desperate to escape, explore everything around you, use your wits, uncover his secrets and face the dread of being in the victim's place. Inspired by a true story.
items.description_ja: 連続殺人犯に誘拐される心理的恐怖を体験せよ。脱出を求めて周囲のすべてを探索し、知恵を絞り、彼の秘密を暴き、被害者の立場に置かれる恐怖と向き合え。実話に着想を得た作品。
items.title: Butcherman

items.description: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.
items.description_ja: 『Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story』は、物語重視のアドベンチャーと容赦ないトップダウンアクションを融合させた作品。人間と動物が暮らす犯罪のはびこる街で、あなたは昼は街の住人、夜は殺し屋。葬られた過去に追いつかれる前に、その真実を掘り起こせ。

items.description: It's Just A Prank is a first-person horror game about kids playing pranks on each other until a PRANK GOES WRONG. Experience suspense, fear, and unexpected twists as a simple joke becomes a nightmare.
items.description_ja: It's Just A Prankは、お互いにいたずらをする子供たちに関する一人称ホラーゲームで、いたずらが裏目に出るまでを描く。一見すると簡単な冗談が悪夢に変わるサスペンス、恐怖、予想外の展開を体験しよう。

items.description: An escape-room styled series of puzzles await in the car that seems to contain neither rhyme nor reason. See if you can solve the mysteries of the photographs, and figure out what it means to be the ONE IN THE BACK.
items.description_ja: 完全に非論理的と思われる車内では、脱出ゲーム風のパズルが待っています。

items.description: "Alice's Gaze" is a dark fairy-tale clicker and idle game. Accompany Alice as she awakens in a strange mansion, gaze upon the cat god's altar, delve into the abyss of terror, revive the slumbering rooms one by one, and search for a way to escape.
items.description_ja: 『Alice's Gaze』は、ダークな童話スタイルのクリッカー＆放置ゲームです。不思議な館で目覚めたアリスと共に、猫神の祭壇を見つめ、恐怖の深淵へと足を踏み入れ、眠りについた部屋を少しずつ蘇らせながら、ここから脱出する方法を探し出しましょう。

items.description: "NARRENSCHIFF" is a psychological horror puzzle game. Players take on the role of an amnesiac man who awakens in a mysterious mental hospital. As they explore, they unravel a story involving their own origins and the conspiracy brewing within the walls of the mental institution.

Short visual novel.
An all-too-familiar story, born from an all-too-familiar motive, on an all-too-familiar street.

短編ビジュアルノベル。
ありふれた目的を胸に、ありふれた街で起こる、ありふれた物語。

items.description_ja: 『The Wellmonts Case』は、1993年のメイン州北部を舞台にした一人称視点の心理ホラーゲームです。私立探偵として、放棄されたWellmont農場を探索し、手がかりを探し、不穏な証拠を撮影し、家族の謎めいた失踪の真相を明らかにします。

items.description_ja: トンネルを掘り、レールを敷け。WHAAG MINING INC.のゴブリン鉱夫として地下で生き延びよう。道を照らさなければ、暗闇がゴブリンを支配する。破壊可能なバイオームを探索したり、敵対する生物と戦ったり、ソロまたはオンライン協力プレイで伝説の巨大クリスタルをゲットしよう。

Operate from a remote command center, issuing indirect orders via multi-screen interfaces. Plan routes, set priorities, and adapt as missions escalate and feel the true weight of being in command.
items.description_ja: あなたが指揮室から指示を出し、部隊を絶望的な戦場に送り込むことになります。戦術装備を整え、リアルタイムで指示を出し、優先任務を選択してください。1発ごとの射撃は操作できませんが、全体の流れを支配し、計算で勝利を掴み取るのです。廃棄された宇宙船の真実を明かしていきましょう。（ローカライズ品質を改善中です）

items.description: Find your community at summer camp, one friendship at a time. Take a beat, enjoy a breath of fresh air - all while playing at the beach, strolling in the woods, and dancing with friends. This short cozy game was created by two dads, celebrating their kids’ journeys to find their voices.
items.description_ja: サマーキャンプでひとりひとりと友情を育み、自分の居場所を見つけよう。ゆったりと新鮮な空気を味わいながらビーチで遊び、森を散歩し、友達とダンスするコージーな短編ゲーム。開発者はふたりの父親。子どもたちが自分の“声”を見つけたことを記念して、このゲームをつくりました。

The last subway departs in a world overrun by zombies.
At each station, gather materials, find better weapons, and fight off the undead.
As you get closer to your family, the danger grows.
Survive, upgrade, and make it to the final stop.

ゾンビが蔓延る世界で最後の地下鉄が出発する。
各ステーションで資材を集め、より優れた武器を見つけて、アンデッドと戦ってください。
家族に近づくほど、危険は増大します。
生き残り、アップグレードして、最後の目的地まで到達しましょう。

items.description_ja: 友達とサルと爆弾解除！「見猿」、「聞か猿」、「言わ猿」の三猿になって協力しよう。必要な情報は各自に一部だけ。意思疎通し、謎を解き、時間と勝負！爆発前に解除できる？

items.description: ASPIS is a story-driven first-person horror game set in the late-1980s USSR. Engineer Andrey enters an experimental system to see his deceased family again. But the machine opens worlds it was never meant to find. Explore the institute and step beyond reality.
items.description_ja: 『ASPIS』は、1980年代末のソ連を舞台にした物語重視の一人称視点ホラーゲーム。技師アンドレイは、亡き家族と再会するため実験システムへ入る。しかし機械は、決して見つけてはならなかった世界への道を開く。研究所を探索し、現実の向こう側へ踏み込め。

HONK!

高度な訓練を受けたガチョウの親として、小さな卵を無事に家へ連れ帰るために協力しよう。ぶつかるほど操作は難しくなり、ミスはさらに面白くなる。2～4人で遊ぶ協力物理ゲーム、チームワークとドタバタとガチョウの鳴き声。
HONK!

items.description_ja: VRでロボットを切り刻もう。剣が金属の体をバラバラにする感覚を味わえ。今、キミはローグライクの死を賭けたトーナメントCrashloopで生死を繰り返している。剣で相手の弱点に踏み込め！手裏剣を飛ばせ！これがHyperdomeの…Clone Droneだ！！！

items.description_ja: 『シープハーズ！』(Sheepherds!) は 1〜4 人で遊べる、癒し系の協力パーティーゲームです。牧羊犬の仲間たちと一緒に美しい風景を駆け抜け、色とりどりの羊の群れを導いて羊毛を集めましょう。吠えて、走って、みんなで楽しむか、チャレンジに挑んでさらなる報酬を手に入れよう！
