But everything comes with a catch, and Roner and his friends are keen to teach you that...
items.description_ja:
You are an ambitious paranormal investigator searching for his big break. When you're presented the opportunity of a lifetime--$25.99, to be exact, you jump at the offer.

But everything comes with a catch, and Roner and his friends are keen to teach you that...
items.title: Five Nights at Roner's: Remastered

items.description: Play the ancient and thrilling game of Chess but with... cats! Lead your furry friends to the Purrfect battle of brains and whiskers!
items.description_ja:
古代のスリリングなチェスを…今度はネコと一緒に！  
モフモフの仲間たちを、ひげと知恵のパーフェクトな戦いへ導け！
items.title: Cat Chess

items.description:
Virtual group - PLAVE doujin game, set against the backdrop of winter school ghost stories.
Experience the Night Patrol Rules of the Seven Mysteries through the eyes of all five band members, uncovering the unsettling truth hidden behind the mystery through your investigation and choices.
items.description_ja:
Virtual group - PLAVE doujin game, set against the backdrop of winter school ghost stories.
Experience the Night Patrol Rules of the Seven Mysteries through the eyes of all five band members, uncovering the unsettling truth hidden behind the mystery through your investigation and choices.
items.title: Night Patrol Rules

items.description: Upon buying a used computer online, I found a short romance game called “Print I Love You”. I played it once, and it’s lingered ever since. I don’t know who made it - only that it was dedicated to someone. Maybe you…
items.description_ja:
ネットで買った中古パソコンの中に、「Print I Love You」という短い恋愛ゲームが入っていた。一度プレイしただけなのに、それ以来ずっと心に残っている。作者は不明。わかっているのは、誰かに捧げられたものだということだけ。もしかしたら、あなたに...

このゲームには、すべての年齢層に適さない内容が含まれる場合があります。
items.title: Print I Love U

items.description: Creepy Tale is a mysterious adventure rich in riddles and eerie atmosphere. An autumn morning promised a quiet fishing trip, but events took Martin to "some other place." Find the way home, uncover loads of secrets, and save everyone that you can.
items.description_ja: Creepy Tale は、謎と不気味な雰囲気に満ちたミステリアスなクエストである。秋の朝、静かな釣りの旅が約束されていたが、ある出来事が主人公を 「別の場所 」へと連れ去った。帰り道を探し、数々の秘密を暴き、できる限りの人々を救おう。
items.title: Creepy Tale: Some Other Place

items.description: Kill everyone in the world with a guillotine… on a cursed Win98 desktop.
items.description_ja: 呪われたWin98デスクトップで、世界中をギロチンで皆殺しにせよ。
items.title: Execute

items.description: Welcome to the world of The Coma 3: Bloodlines. In this realm of shadows rumors and urban legends become reality, and danger lurks around every corner. If a living intruder dies here, their body will be severed from their spirit and never wake again ...
items.description_ja: 『The Coma 3: Bloodlines』（ザ・コーマ3：ブラッドラインズ）の世界へようこそ。この影の領域では噂と都市伝説が現実と化し、あらゆる場所に危険が潜む。侵入した生者はここで死ぬと、その身体は魂から切り離され、二度と目覚めることはない……
items.title: The Coma 3: Bloodlines

items.description: Fishing at the Lake Full of Cats is a puzzle solving, cat collecting, fishing game where you uncover the secrets of Silly Lake in a quest to fish up every last one of its pointy eared denizens.
items.description_ja: Fishing at the Lake Full of Cats is a puzzle solving, cat collecting, fishing game where you uncover the secrets of Silly Lake in a quest to fish up every last one of its pointy eared denizens.
items.title: Fishing at the Lake Full of Cats

items.description: In this horror, comedy, and puzzle game, you will play as a demon summoned by an old woman to fix her television, sending you on an adventure beyond all reason.
items.description_ja: In this horror, comedy, and puzzle game, you will play as a demon summoned by an old woman to fix her television, sending you on an adventure beyond all reason.
items.title: OH DEMON! Fix my TV

items.description: Steal $5,000 from an abandoned apartment complex while avoiding a demented man.
items.description_ja: 廃墟となったマンションから5,000ドルを盗み出し、その際、狂った男をかわす。
items.title: The Wheelchair Man

items.description: Explore a world built from the luscious landscapes, turbulent townscapes and preposterous portraits of real Renaissance paintings. Death of the Reprobate is a Rabelaisian adventure game from the creator of Four Last Things and The Procession to Calvary.
items.description_ja: 官能的な地形、波乱の街並み、実際のルネサンス絵画を滑稽に描いた作品。『Death of the Reprobate』は『Four Last Things』『The Procession to Calvary』の製作者が贈る、ラブレーに影響を受けた冒険ゲーム。
items.title: Death of the Reprobate

items.description:
Plunge into high-stakes punishment platforming in JUMP KING QUEST! Explore alone or fall together in dynamic online climbing action as you fight your way upwards on an unhinged quest to The Smoking Hot Babe at The Top. 
In this world, every ledge is a battlefield…
items.description_ja:
『JUMP KING QUEST』で、高リスクなパニッシュメント・プラットフォームアクションに飛び込もう！ひとりで探索するもよし、オンラインのダイナミックな登頂アクションで一緒に落ちるもよし。頂上にいる〈ぴっちぴちのギャル〉を目指す、正気の沙汰じゃないクエストの道中で、戦いながら上へ上へと突き進め。 
この世界では、足場ひとつが戦場だ…
items.title: JUMP KING QUEST

items.description:
A fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting,
where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING. Play through the Italian restaurant and get a taste of The Chef's Shift!
items.description_ja:
レストランを舞台にしたテンポの速いタイピングゲーム。
お腹を空かせたお客さんに料理を作り、サーブする。すべてタイピングで行う。イタリアンレストランでプレイして、味を確かめてください！
items.title: The Chef's Shift: First Course

items.description: Your goal is simple, spot anomalies to escape. Play alone or together with up to 8 players in online co-op. Make the right decisions to advance to the next level, or risk being reset to the beginning!
items.description_ja: 目的はシンプル。異常を見つけて脱出せよ。ソロでも、最大 8 人のオンライン協力プレイでも楽しめます。正しい選択をして次のレベルへ進むか、それとも最初からやり直すか——すべてはあなた次第です。
items.title: The Anomaly Project

items.description: Egg Squeeze is a biological intuition test where you squeeze eggs for as long as you can without breaking them.
items.description_ja: Egg Squeeze is a biological intuition test where you squeeze eggs for as long as you can without breaking them.
items.title: Egg Squeeze

items.description: Years into a brutal lockdown, a once-thriving city lies in ruins, abandoned by its government and overrun by vicious, mindless infected. Grab your hammer, collect your nerves and enter the mayhem.
items.description_ja: Years into a brutal lockdown, a once-thriving city lies in ruins, abandoned by its government and overrun by vicious, mindless infected. Grab your hammer, collect your nerves and enter the mayhem.
items.title: DEAD TRASH

items.description:
💼 A simple task: Don’t press the red button. Sounds easy? 😏
Featuring an annoying voice, absurd endings, and too many achievements.
Free. Pointless. Glorious. 🤡🔴
items.description_ja:
💼 A simple task: Don’t press the red button. Sounds easy? 😏
Featuring an annoying voice, absurd endings, and too many achievements.
Free. Pointless. Glorious. 🤡🔴
items.title: A Simple job

items.description: A unicycle, a bomb ready to blow, and sausages struggling to balance! Cooperate with your friends or blow them up in this 2-4 player physics-based chaos game! Reach the summit before the bomb goes off. Don't fall, don't explode, and try to stay a sausage!
items.description_ja: 一輪車、爆発寸前の爆弾、そしてバランスを取ろうと必死なソーセージたち！2〜4人で遊べるこの物理演算カオスゲームで、友達と協力するか、それとも彼らを爆破するか！爆弾が爆発する前に山の頂上を目指しましょう。落ちるな、爆発するな、ソーセージのままでいろ！
items.title: Unicycle Together

items.description:
Suspicious Downpour is a very short single-player comedy horror experience about getting stuck in a storm while out camping.
Sit in your tent with your trusty flashlight in the calm rain and just relax. Just be warned If you look for trouble you might find it.
items.description_ja:
サスピシャスダウンポールは短いのコメディーホラーゲームです、ストーリーは台風中森に困っています。
信頼できる懐中電灯を持ってテントに座って、雨を聞きながら休むですが
危ないことを探したら、危ないことを見つかるかも。
items.title: Suspicious Downpour

items.description: Survive 5 nights in the heart of northeastern Argentina as a local farmer and reveal the truth behind the haunting tales of the Pombero in a world where folklore meets terror.
items.description_ja: アルゼンチン北東部の心臓で5夜を生き延び、フォークロアが恐怖と出会う世界で、ポンベロのぞましい物語の真実を発見せよ。
items.title: Pomberito

items.description: Battle your way to victory in this 1-4 player co-op hack-n-slash dungeon crawler completely remastered! Play as a dynamic cast of heroes slicing their way through dungeons, earning weapons and loot. Rampage past a gauntlet of enemies and destruction to end the evil Lord Dinglepus' reign!
items.description_ja: Battle your way to victory in this 1-4 player co-op hack-n-slash dungeon crawler. Play as a dynamic cast of heroes slicing their way through dungeons, earning weapons and loot. Rampage past a gauntlet of enemies and destruction to end the evil Lord Dinglepus' reign!
items.title: Dungeon Rampage Remastered

items.description:
This game is a rhythm action game in which the player purifies souls by pinching them with girls' thighs!
The player controls the thighs and pinches the flowing souls in rhythm.
Let's purify souls by pinching them with thighs in rhythm!
Let's Paradise!
items.description_ja:
このゲームは、ふとももで魂を挟んで浄化するリズムアクションゲームです！
プレイヤーは太ももを操作して、流れてくる魂をリズムに乗って挟んでいきます。
ふとももで、魂をリズム良く挟んで浄化しよう！！
Let'sパラダイス！！
items.title: MOMO Crash

items.description: In this classic point-and-click adventure anthology by award-winning indie developer Scriptwelder, you'll protect an unsuspecting hamlet from yourself, try to prepare for an incoming undead horde, and search a seemingly empty spaceship for answers to a gruesome mystery.
items.description_ja: In this classic point-and-click adventure anthology by award-winning indie developer Scriptwelder, you'll protect an unsuspecting hamlet from yourself, try to prepare for an incoming undead horde, and search a seemingly empty spaceship for answers to a gruesome mystery.
items.title: Don't Escape Trilogy

items.description:
Bite-sized surreal horror with multiple choices.
Make your own way through the claymation madness!
items.description_ja: 選択肢が複数ある一口サイズのシュールホラー。クレイアニメーションの狂気の中、自分だけの道を切り開け！
items.title: Isolomus

items.description: She's here to help! Let Sakuya Izayoi from the Touhou Project comfort you after encountering some hardships in this beautiful visual novel that aims to heal your troubles away!
items.description_ja: 咲夜さんがあなたをお助けします！東方Projectの十六夜咲夜が、苦境に立たされたあなたを癒やす、美麗なイラストでお送りするビジュアルノベル！
items.title: Save Me, Sakuya-san!

items.description: “Pieces of Me” is not a classic horror game with jump scares, but a psychological thriller-drama in the walking simulator genre. It is a spin-off of “September 7th”
items.description_ja: “Pieces of Me” is not a classic horror game with jump scares, but a psychological thriller-drama in the walking simulator genre. It is a spin-off of “September 7th”
items.title: Pieces of me

items.description: Lycans is a multiplayer game. It can accommodate up to 12 players. Investigate to find the werewolves hiding among the villagers during the day and hide at night to survive their attacks !
items.description_ja: Lycans is a multiplayer game. It can accommodate up to 12 players. Investigate to find the werewolves hiding among the villagers during the day and hide at night to survive their attacks !
items.title: Lycans

items.description: You awaken to whispers of an ancient cult and their unholy rite. As the veil to the dead unravels, explore, solve puzzles, and escape - before you become part of the ritual.
items.description_ja: You awaken to whispers of an ancient cult and their unholy rite. As the veil to the dead unravels, explore, solve puzzles, and escape - before you become part of the ritual.
items.title: Hellkind

items.description: Plinko-style INCREMENTAL game. Shoot gumballs at gears and buy upgrades to make bigger and bigger numbers until you break the game! Short, sweet, relaxing, and addictive!
items.description_ja: ピンボール風放置ゲーム！ガムボールをギアに撃ち込み、アップグレードを購入してどんどん資産が増えまくる。ついにゲームの限界を突破せよ！短くて濃密、リラックスできてついハマってしまう作品です！
items.title: Idle Gumball Machine

items.description: Unlucky Mummy is an incremental clicker where your task is to open a sarcophagus with a curse on it. Starting with a tiny chance of success, can you find 12 relics in a row to resurrect the mummy?
items.description_ja: 『Unlucky Mummy』は、呪いのかかった石棺を開けていく放置系タップゲームです。最初の成功率は、なんと25%。12個のレリックを連続で見つけ出し、ミイラを復活させることはできるだろうか？
items.title: Unlucky Mummy

items.description:
You have the briefcase. Now it's after you. It's not going to stop. Be careful—it may take the form of someone else.
A short horror game by NIGHT DIAL.
items.description_ja:
You have the briefcase. Now it's after you. It's not going to stop. Be careful—it may take the form of someone else.
A short horror game by NIGHT DIAL.
items.title: CROWDED. FOLLOWED.

items.description: The game takes place in the world of the Cretaceous Period... Dinosaurs attack players in various scenes, including jungles, caves, lakes, and some buildings eroded by plants! Use the characteristics of increased number of weapons to overcome difficult challenges!
items.description_ja: ゲームの舞台は、白亜紀の世界へ…。ジャングルや洞窟、湖、なかには植物に侵食された建物など、さまざまなシーンで恐竜たちがプレイヤーに襲い掛かる！扱える武器も増加し、それぞれの特徴を活かし、難関を突破せよ！
items.title: Dino Crisis 2

items.description: Faced with the cruel and harsh reality of homelessness, you seek out affordable housing in your area. Luckily, it seems you've found the perfect rental, but something is very off about your landlord...
items.description_ja: Faced with the cruel and harsh reality of homelessness, you seek out affordable housing in your area. Luckily, it seems you've found the perfect rental, but something is very off about your landlord...
items.title: My Sweet! Housemate

items.description:
This is a relaxing atmospheric game where you simply watch a robot catch creatures.
Place it at the edge of your screen like a vertical desktop accessory and observe the ecosystem.
It’s neither an idle game with mountains of stats nor an exciting fishing game.
items.description_ja:
ロボットが生き物を釣るのを眺めるだけの雰囲気ゲームです。
縦長のデスクトップアクセサリのように画面端に配置して生態系を眺めてください。
山のような数字が出る放置ゲームでも、エキサイティングな釣りゲームでもありません。
items.title: Fishing The Abyss

items.description: Haunted Heist is a 3-8 player round-based PvP horror party game where Heisters find and retrieve gems in a procedurally generated mansion, while Tricksters use chaotic abilities to distress, disrupt, and dispose of them to protect their home.
items.description_ja: Haunted Heistは3〜8人で遊ぶラウンド制のPvPホラーパーティーゲームです。ハイスターがランダム生成された屋敷内で宝石を探し集め、トリックスターが混沌とした能力を使ってハイスターを苦しめ、妨害し、そして排除しながら自分たちの家を守ります。
items.title: Haunted Heist

items.description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.
items.description_ja: かわいい生き物を缶詰にする、一人称視点のインクリメンタルゲーム。生産ラインが軌道に乗ると、これが気持ちいい。倒して、死体を集めて、缶詰にして売りさばこう。稼いだお金で武器や機械を強化して、どんどん生産量を増やそう。
items.title: Can 'Em All

items.description: [Bober Bros] The Hole is a first-person horror game that explores the cracks in domestic life. Your neighbor’s drilling starts the nightmare, but the holes reveal dark secrets far deeper than any wall could hide. No cheap scares, only disturbing reality.
items.description_ja: [Bober Bros] The Holeは家庭生活のひびを探る一人称ホラーゲームです。隣人のドリルが悪夢を引き起こしますが、穴は壁より深い暗い秘密を暴きます。安い驚きではなく、心を乱す現実。
items.title: [Bober Bros] The Hole

items.description: Handyman needed - ASAP! The investor’s coming in the morning, and the house still isn’t ready! Take on an extra shift where horror meets simulation. Tackle the chaos, uncover dark secrets, and finish everything before dawn.
items.description_ja: 修理工募集—至急！ 投資家は明日の朝に来るのに、家はまだ準備ができていません！ホラーとシミュレーションが交わる追加のシフトを引き受けてください。混乱を解決し、暗い秘密を暴き、夜明け前にすべてを終わらせましょう。
items.title: Creepy Shift: House For Sale

items.description: A party game that supports online multiplayer for up to 8 players, where you can also create mods together. It features asymmetric gameplay with cute animals and the beloved platforming fun.
items.description_ja: 最大8人でのオンラインマルチプレイ対応パーティゲーム。MODの共同制作も可能で、主な特徴は可愛い動物たちによる非対称対戦と、定番のジャンプアクションの楽しさです。
items.title: NiuMa

items.description: Yoko no Hanashi is a first-person survival horror game where you need to survive in an abandoned college with one of your chosen yandere: Yoto (male version) and Yoko (female version)
items.description_ja: Yoko no Hanashi is a first-person survival horror game where you need to survive in an abandoned college with one of your chosen yandere: Yoto (male version) and Yoko (female version)
items.title: Yoko no Hanashi

items.description:
A co-op game for 1-6+ players where you fall, dig, and explode your way down a dangerous cave system to find your lost dog.
Catch your friends and watch your step on this journey full of traps, hazards, and the most deadly force of all: gravity.
Will you jump into the unknown to rescue your dog?
items.description_ja: 危険に満ちた洞窟を、落ちて、掘って、爆破して突き進みながら迷子になった愛犬を探す協力プレイゲームです。冒険には罠や困難、そして最大の敵である「重力」が待ち受けています。フレンドをキャッチし、自分の足元にも十分に注意しましょう！愛犬を救うため、あなたは未知の空間に飛び込む勇気がありますか？
items.title: Pratfall

items.description: A late-night thrill turns into a nightmare. Olivia sneaks into Creepwood Wonderland Carnival with her boyfriend, expecting a fun night alone in the park. But something feels off. Distant footsteps. Faint whispers. Someone else is here… Watching.
items.description_ja: 深夜のスリルが悪夢へと変わる。オリビアは彼氏とクリープウッド・ワンダーランド・カーニバルに忍び込み、パーク内で二人きりの楽しい一夜を過ごすつもりだった。でも、何かがおかしい。遠くで聞こえる足音。かすかに囁く声。ここには他に誰かがいる… 見られている。
items.title: The Stalked 3

items.description: Void of Lilly is an adventure in the world of the near future with JRPG elements and Bullet Hell battles! Help Ann to find her sister and uncover secrets of this world... Void of Lilly is coming on Steam for free!
items.description_ja: 『Void of Lilly』は、JRPGの要素と弾幕バトルを融合させた、近未来SFアドベンチャーです！主人公のアンを操作して妹を探し出し、この世界の秘密を解き明かしましょう。『Void of Lilly』はSteamにて無料配信中です！
items.title: Void of Lilly

items.description: Skewer Squad is a cute yet chaotic tower defense roguelite. Step into the apron of a Grillmaster, draft random ingredients, mix wild seasonings, and build a squad of skewers that are both delicious and powerful to defend your grill.
items.description_ja:
『ひっぱるなよ、串焼きマスター！』は、可愛くて少しカオスな、ローグライク×タワーディフェンスゲームである。
串焼きマスターとしてランダムに食材を引き当て、調味料を組み合わせながら「おいしくて強力な串焼きチーム」を作り上げ、
迫りくる敵から焼き台を守り抜きましょう！
items.title: Skewer Squad

items.description: Raise the Colours is a satirical 4-player co-op physics game where you race to plant flags before the timer runs out. Work together (or trip each other up) while dodging pesky council workers who’ll do anything to shut down your fun. Not allowed!
items.description_ja: Raise the Colours is a satirical 4-player co-op physics game where you race to plant flags before the timer runs out. Work together (or trip each other up) while dodging pesky council workers who’ll do anything to shut down your fun. Not allowed!
items.title: Raise the Colours

items.description: Dig your way out of hell with a rusty spoon! Crawl through ancient abandoned tunnels. Discover remnants of a ritual never meant to be seen. Crank the lights on and get to the other side before they go out! Don't let them see you. Down here you’re not exploring... you're trespassing.
items.description_ja:
井戸は枯れ果てた。その原因を突き止めるのは、あなただ。
廃墟と化した地下道を進む中で、決して見られるはずのなかった儀式の痕跡に出くわす。
壊れかけの機械を起動させ、暗闇に光を灯せ。
崩れた土を掘り進み、地の底から這い上がれ。
この地下深くでは、あなたは探検者ではない…
侵入者だ。
items.title: THE WELL IS NOT EMPTY

items.description: An RPG set in a distant, lonely future. Follow Arem, a young man lured from his small island community to explore the desolate megastructure beneath it: “The Well.” With the simple goal of finding the exit, Arem will burden himself with something more terrible than he ever thought possible.
items.description_ja: An RPG set in a distant, lonely future. Follow Arem, a young man lured from his small island community to explore the desolate megastructure beneath it: “The Well.” With the simple goal of finding the exit, Arem will burden himself with something more terrible than he ever thought possible.
items.title: A Song Of Sunlight

items.description: Yes! In this 3D hidden object game, you must blast 100 toy ducks! Relax, take aim, and let the feathers fly! With light-hearted gameplay and cute ducks to hunt, it's a casual first-person experience full of wholesome, family-friendly fun!
items.description_ja: はい！この3Dアイテム探しゲームでは、100羽のおもちゃのアヒルを撃ち落とさなければなりません！リラックスして、狙いを定め、羽を飛ばしましょう！ライトなゲームプレイとかわいいアヒルの狩りで、家族みんなで楽しめるカジュアルな一人称視点の体験です。
items.title: Find 100 Ducks and Blast Them!

items.description: “Troll” is such a strong word for this 2D platformer with nearly 240 uniquely inventive levels. Don’t let screaming YouTubers convince you that this game is unfair. It’s fair. Sure, there are buzzsaws but they’re NICE buzzsaws. You will curse the guy who made Level Devil (Me😈) then ask for more.
items.description_ja: Level Devil《レベルデビル》は、クラシックなプラットフォーミングゲームやフラッシュ時代、そしてもしかしたら解決されていない子供時代のいじめからインスピレーションを受けた、カラフルでミニマリストな世界を舞台にしたユーモラスな2Dプラットフォーマーです。
items.title: Level Devil

items.description: Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, in this short Action-Adventure FPS made by a team of third-year university students.
items.description_ja: Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, in this short Action-Adventure FPS made by a team of third-year university students.
items.title: DREADTOME

items.description: This will be the most thrilling pool game you have ever played. Join up to 3 of your friends in this exciting pool roulette game! Eliminate each other with pool until only one person is left.
items.description_ja: これは、あなたが今までプレイした中で最もスリリングなビリヤードゲームになります。友達を最大3人参加させ、このエキサイティングなプールルーレットゲームに挑もう！最後の一人になるまでプールで相手を排除してください。
items.title: Nine-Ball Roulette

items.description: In this short first-person psychological horror game, falling asleep on the subway takes you to the final station, abandoned and eerie. Explore the area and try to survive the entity chasing you in the darkness. Who is it? Its face looks strangely familiar...
items.description_ja:
この短編一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラーゲームでは、地下鉄でうたた寝をすると、不気味に廃墟と化した終着駅にたどり着きます。
暗闇の中であなたを追ってくる存在から逃れながら、探索し、生き残る方法を見つけてください。
それは誰なのか？ その顔には見覚えがあるような気がする…。
items.title: THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano

items.description: Paint the bunny man and blend into the scene like a chameleon! 2–10 player online hide-and-seek. Sample colors, match the lighting, tune your materials — disguise yourself to perfection and slip away right under the Hunters' gaze.
items.description_ja: バニーマンに色をぬって、カメレオンみたいに風景にとけこもう！2〜10人のオンラインかくれんぼ。色をひろい、光を合わせ、マテリアルを調整して、完璧に化けきる——ハンターの視線をかいくぐり、生きのびろ。
items.title: SCRIBBLE HUNT

items.description: VULTURES is a tactical turn-based survival horror, inspired by 90's survival horror classics. As an operative, scavenge the infested metropolis for materials and information that could cure the infection plaguing the world.
items.description_ja: 90年代サバイバルホラーの原点『バイオハザード』へのオマージュ。封鎖された死都を探索し、息詰まる孤立と血に飢えた変異体に立ち向かえ。砕け散った真実を拾い集め、極限の資源管理の中で一手一手を見極める。退路を失い、弾薬が尽きた時、冷静な思考だけが絶望の中に生路を導く。
items.title: Vultures - Scavengers of Death

items.description: Over or Under? A simple game of gambling with your life.
items.description_ja: Over or Under? A simple game of gambling with your life.
items.title: FLATHEAD

items.description: Bite Night is a comedic first-person horror game that explores the idea of what if the big bad monster was bad at their job of being scary.
items.description_ja: Bite Night is a comedic first-person horror game that explores the idea of what if the big bad monster was bad at their job of being scary.
items.title: Bite Night

items.description: White Wool & Snow is the second visual novel in the Misericorde series.
items.description_ja: White Wool & Snow is the second visual novel in the Misericorde series.
items.title: Misericorde Volume Two: White Wool & Snow

items.description: Highschool student Haneko has forgotten her class assignments and must retrieve them by traversing a world of haunted horrors. Explore the dilapidated halls, find your missing homework, and avoid whatever's lurking around the corner in this bite-sized, retro survival horror experience.
items.description_ja: あなたはハネコとして深夜の学校を渡り歩き、宿題を回収せねばならない。固定カメラアングルとレトロ調グラフィックのホラーサバイバル。荒れ果てたホールを探索し、潜むアノマリーを避けながら宿題を見つけ出そう。
items.title: Late Homework | 遅れた宿題

items.description: Find your missing friend. Uncover the secrets within. Brave a luxurious and haunting mansion in Dead Take, a first-person psychological horror crafted by Surgent Studios.
items.description_ja: 行方不明の友人を探し出し、隠された真実を暴け。Surgent Studios が手がける一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー『Dead Take / デッドテイク』で、豪奢にして不気味な邸宅に挑め。
items.title: Dead Take

items.description: Beni, a loving husband to Nadia and father to Kaila, always ensured his family's needs were met with simple contentment. However, one day, an unwitting decision dragged his small family into a spiral that threatens everything.
items.description_ja: Beni, a loving husband to Nadia and father to Kaila, always ensured his family's needs were met with simple contentment. However, one day, an unwitting decision dragged his small family into a spiral that threatens everything.
items.title: Pikabuu: STOP!

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game. Explore a maze-like alleyway, using your camera to distinguish between supernatural "Aberrations" and deceptive "Deceptions" while escaping the relentless pursuit of a vengeful ghost.
items.description_ja: 無限に続く迷路のような路地裏を探索する、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー。カメラを通して「鬼痕」と「幻象」を見極め、迫りくる鬼の追跡を逃れて脱出を目指しましょう。
items.title: The Alley

items.description: you find an abandoned fps game on an old computer. you decide to play it.
items.description_ja: あなたは古いコンピューターの中に、もう遊ばれなくなったFPSゲームを見つけて、プレイすることにしました。
items.title: No Players Online

items.description: School 666 is a 1-4 Player Co-op Survival Horror. You must escape this endless nightmare. Try to identify the correct path and survive the anomalies in this endless school. Some extremely powerful anomalies will catch you to their dimensions. Explore the reason why you are here... and don't die.
items.description_ja: スクール666は、1〜4人のプレイヤーが協力して生き残るホラーゲームです。この終わりのない学校で正しい道を見つけ、異常現象から生き残りましょう。一部の強力な異常現象は、あなたを自分の次元に引き込むでしょう。なぜあなたがここにいるのかを探り… そして死なないようにしましょう。
items.title: School 666

items.description: Crawl through pipes, navigate the maze, listen carefully and get out before Rodland finds you.
items.description_ja: Crawl through pipes, navigate the maze, listen carefully and get out before Rodland finds you.
items.title: Rodland of Pipes

items.description: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.
items.description_ja: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.
items.title: Normal Golf Game

items.description: Build your audience as a content creator in this streaming simulator roleplaying game. Riskier moves bring more viewers to your channel but raise notoriety. Push the edgy content too much and you’ll be banned. Balance hype and caution to stay live, gain viewers, and become the Content King!
items.description_ja: このストリーミングシミュレーションRPGで、コンテンツクリエイターとして視聴者層を拡大しよう。リスクの高い行動はチャンネル登録者数を増やす一方で、悪評も高めてしまう。過激なコンテンツをやりすぎると、アカウント停止の危機に。注目度と慎重さのバランスを取りながら、配信を続け、視聴者を増やし、コンテンツキングを目指せ！
items.title: Content King

items.description: Slide chunks of the world to solve puzzles and help others. Control an ever-growing set of tiles and mechanics. Explore nine unique areas, unravel the mysteries of the universe, and reconnect the world -- one slider at a time.
items.description_ja: Slide chunks of the world to solve puzzles and help others. Control an ever-growing set of tiles and mechanics. Explore nine unique areas, unravel the mysteries of the universe, and reconnect the world -- one slider at a time.
items.title: Slider

items.description: Featuring a blend of 2D adventure and visual novel, The Mildew Children is a grim tale about a village inhabited only by children who follow savage pagan traditions. A young witch named Kyrphel, along with her sisters, are bound to perform a macabre Ritual in order to save their village.
items.description_ja: 2Dアドベンチャーとビジュアル・ノベルを融合させた「The Mildew Children」は、野蛮な異教徒の伝統に従う子供たちだけが住む村についての厳しい物語である。若い魔女キルフェルとその姉妹は、村を救うために不気味な儀式を行うことになる。
items.title: The Mildew Children

items.description: FREE DUROV – Dive into the most meme-worthy horror game. Experience the hardships of prison life and try to escape by securing the encryption keys. Save anonymity!
items.description_ja: FREE DUROV – こんばんは！あなたは最も記憶に残るホラーに迷い込みました。刑務所生活の困難をすべて体感し、暗号キーを持ち去って脱出を試みてください。匿名性を守りましょう！
items.title: FREE DUROV

items.description: Autumn, 1992. Anton, a 14-year-old boy, moves with his parents to a small town and is left alone in his grandmother's apartment. Meanwhile, children are disappearing across the town — the police are powerless, and no one knows who's behind it…
items.description_ja: 1992年の秋。14歳の少年アントンは両親とともに小さな町へ引っ越し、祖母のアパートに一人残される。そんな中、町では子どもたちの失踪事件が相次いでいた——警察は無力で、誰が黒幕なのか誰にもわからない……
items.title: Uncanny Tales: 1992

items.description: Dread Neighbor is a first-person, multi-perspective psychological horror game. Play as a young woman living alone in an unusually cheap apartment. As the days pass, combat the overwhelming sense of unease, malice, and the unshakable feeling that you’re being watched from every crack in the room.
items.description_ja: 『悪意（Dread Neighbor）』は、3D一人称・マルチ視点の心理ホラーゲーム。プレイヤーは一人暮らしの若い女性となり、節約のために新しくも異様に家賃の安いアパートへ引っ越し、かつてない「悪意」を感じ始める。クローゼットの隙間、ベッドの下、壁の奥、あらゆる隙間から、無数の視線が見つめてくる。
items.title: Dread Neighbor

items.description: Teacup is a short and wholesome narrative adventure game with a focus on exploration and non-linear progression. Help a small and shy frog on her journey to find the ingredients she needs for her tea party!
items.description_ja: Teacup is a short and wholesome narrative adventure game with a focus on exploration and non-linear progression. Help a small and shy frog on her journey to find the ingredients she needs for her tea party!
items.title: Teacup

items.description:
Simple Fish Adventure is an unusual short physics-based platformer. Jump like a fish, think like a fish, be a fish! Overcome obstacles and suffer.
Also includes co-op for up to 4 players.
items.description_ja:
Simple Fish Adventure is an unusual short physics-based platformer. Jump like a fish, think like a fish, be a fish! Overcome obstacles and suffer.
Also includes co-op for up to 4 players.
items.title: Simple Fish Adventure

items.description: Growing My Grandpa! is a Cronenberg-inspired point-and-click adventure game with virtual pet elements that puts a heavy emphasis on exploration and lore.
items.description_ja: Growing My Grandpa! is a Cronenberg-inspired point-and-click adventure game with virtual pet elements that puts a heavy emphasis on exploration and lore.
items.title: Growing My Grandpa!

items.description: Fight with your whole body. If you lose an arm, it's just a scratch. If you lose the other, it's a flesh wound. If you lose your legs, headbutt them. LET'S FIGHT, FIGHT, FIGHT!
items.description_ja: 全身全霊で戦え。腕を失ってもかすり傷で済む。もう片方を失えば、肉弾戦だ。足を失ったら頭突きだ！ レッツファイト、ファイト、ファイト
items.title: Knock'Em Out

items.description: All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets.
items.description_ja: All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets.
items.title: Quiet is the Eyes

items.description: You have been assigned to guard a dragon girl set to be executed at the end of 5 days and have the ability to kill her instantly at any time with the push of a button in this multi-ending visual novel.
items.description_ja:
『イツカノヨル』は「即処刑出来るボタン」を前に
5日後に処刑される死刑囚である竜族の少女と過ごす
マルチエンド方式のノベルゲームです。
items.title: 5omeday

items.description: Continuation of the legendary saga about the naughty Timokha and his delicious pie!
items.description_ja: Continuation of the legendary saga about the naughty Timokha and his delicious pie!
items.title: 5 NIGHTS AT SHALUN 4: SCHOOL

items.description: The loan shark is coming for you. Catch enough fish to repay your debt before it is too late. Go fish.
items.description_ja: サメは金を返せと要求している。手遅れになる前に、十分な魚を捕まえて借金を返済せよ。釣るか、釣られるか。
items.title: Loan Shark

items.description: Fragments of Dread is an episodic psychological horror series. Each episode tells a self-contained story of dread, fear, and survival.
items.description_ja: Fragments of Dread はエピソード形式の心理ホラーシリーズです。各エピソードは恐怖とサバイバルの独立した物語を描きます。
items.title: Fragments of Dread - False Haven

items.description: Sit back and relax with a desktop fishing game that stays in the corner of your screen. Catch fish, cook recipes, upgrade your gear, and complete your collection guide. Customize your character’s look and even design your very own custom fish to catch!
items.description_ja: 画面の片隅に釣り人を浮かべてでのんびり楽しめるデスクトップ釣りゲームです。魚を釣り、料理し、装備を強化しながら図鑑を完成させましょう。釣り人のスキンはもちろん、釣り上げる魚まで自由にかわいくカスタムできます！
items.title: SCREENSIDE FISHER

items.description: Hello! Hi! How are you? It's time to play! TAKE CARE OF THE DOG is a short story about... taking care of a dog! Play around, follow him, find items, go get the water in the basement (for some reason) and a lot more!
items.description_ja: こんにちは！やあ！元気ですか？さあ、遊びましょう！『TAKE CARE OF THE DOG』は…犬のお世話をする、ちょっとしたストーリーです！自由に動き回ったり、犬について行ったり、アイテムを見つけたり、地下室にある水ボトルを取りに行ったり（なぜか）、他にもいろいろ楽しめます！
items.title: TAKE CARE OF THE DOG

items.description: A psychological mystery yuri visual novel about a girl named Amelie. Forbidden from leaving the house, Amelie awaits the arrival of her long time penpal, Sofia, to her dear friend Lilika’s dismay. What secrets will Sofia unravel that were best kept buried?
items.description_ja: A psychological mystery yuri visual novel about a girl named Amelie. Forbidden from leaving the house, Amelie awaits the arrival of her long time penpal, Sofia, to her dear friend Lilika’s dismay. What secrets will Sofia unravel that were best kept buried?
items.title: Amelie

items.description: This small Narrative Point & Click (Puzzle) game is about the mental health struggles of a adolescent high school dropout who's lost at life. Find out what they're struggling with, you might even recognize some things from your own life.
items.description_ja: This small Narrative Point & Click (Puzzle) game is about the mental health struggles of a adolescent high school dropout who's lost at life. Find out what they're struggling with, you might even recognize some things from your own life.
items.title: "LIFE" not found;

items.description: Snap your own homemade liminal space photos using a mysterious SLR camera as you explore a variety of empty, strange, and familiar spaces.
items.description_ja: Snap your own homemade liminal space photos using a mysterious SLR camera as you explore a variety of empty, strange, and familiar spaces.
items.title: Interior Worlds

items.description: Ghost Janitors is a multiplayer psychological horror game for 1-4 players. Your job? Cleaning haunted houses while avoiding terrifying monsters. Ready to face the spine-tingling challenge with your team?
items.description_ja: Ghost Janitors は、1～4人で遊べるマルチプレイ対応の心理ホラーゲームです。あなたの仕事は？ 恐ろしいモンスターを避けながら、幽霊屋敷を清掃すること。仲間と一緒に、この背筋が凍る挑戦に立ち向かう覚悟はありますか？
items.title: Ghost Janitors

items.description: The Bleakest Keep is a challenging action horror roguelike. Survive the horrors of the Keep, upgrade your gear, and earn ranks as you ascend the tower and save the world!
items.description_ja: The Bleakest Keep is a challenging action horror roguelike. Survive the horrors of the Keep, upgrade your gear, and earn ranks as you ascend the tower and save the world!
items.title: The Bleakest Keep

items.description: A short first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave.
items.description_ja: A short first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave.
items.title: Midnight Snack

items.description: A beautiful Dark Knightess from another world enlisted me in her quest to slay a rogue wizard, and now we're dating! But what if she finds out I have no idea who the Gray Wizard is?!
items.description_ja: A beautiful Dark Knightess from another world enlisted me in her quest to slay a rogue wizard, and now we're dating! But what if she finds out I have no idea who the Gray Wizard is?!
items.title: taking my Dark Knight Girlfriend to the corner store

items.description: A short active incremental game with a satirical story about extreme growth. Help a little snail turn a desert into lush forest it can abuse for profit. Hire minions, unlock immoral plants, get ungodly rich, and remember: Blood is a type of juice.
items.description_ja: カタツムリパワーで砂漠を緑の森へと育て、究極レベルまで利益の最大化を目指すアクティブインクリメンタルゲーム。植物を最適な配置にして、複数の資源の生産を自動化。ミニオンを雇い、不徳な植物を解放して罪深き大金持ちを目指そう。そして忘れるな：血もエキスの一種だ。
items.title: Feed The Forest

items.description: Your parents have left, and you're home alone. What begins as an ordinary evening after school slowly turns into a living nightmare, where every little sound makes your heart race. Remember the most important rule: don't open the door for anyone.
items.description_ja: Your parents have left, and you're home alone. What begins as an ordinary evening after school slowly turns into a living nightmare, where every little sound makes your heart race. Remember the most important rule: don't open the door for anyone.
items.title: Can I Come In?

items.description: An online co-op horror game featuring unique playable characters and RPG mechanics. Exorcise ghosts using your special abilities and tools while surviving the supernatural onslaught
items.description_ja: PROJECT UNKNOWNは、ユニークなプレイ可能なキャラクターと特殊能力を備えた、1～4人でプレイするオンライン協力型ホラーゲームです。さまざまな幽霊を追い払い、さまざまなツールを活用し、恐ろしいビジュアルと複雑なメカニズムに満ちた体験に没頭しましょう。
items.title: Project Unknown

items.description: A short, choose your own adventure game about two boys that find each other in a lonely, post-apocalyptic town.
items.description_ja: A short, choose your own adventure game about two boys that find each other in a lonely, post-apocalyptic town.
items.title: Nocturnals

items.description: Celebrate Halloween night with cute capybaras with orange! Find all the hidden capybaras in their Halloween costumes and light up the town on this magical night. A fun-filled adventure awaits you!
items.description_ja: Celebrate Halloween night with cute capybaras with orange! Find all the hidden capybaras in their Halloween costumes and light up the town on this magical night. A fun-filled adventure awaits you!
items.title: Hidden Capybaras with Orange and Pumpkins: Spooky Halloween Edition

items.description: Intellica thanks you for volunteering in this short text-based Research Study. Pay attention to the participants answers, and classify them as either Human or Artificial. Join us in shaping the future of technology. Remember, think happy!
items.description_ja: Intellica thanks you for volunteering in this short text-based Research Study. Pay attention to the participants answers, and classify them as either Human or Artificial. Join us in shaping the future of technology. Remember, think happy!
items.title: qualia

items.description: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to grow your business.
items.description_ja: タピるお茶屋は、タピるお茶屋を経営しながら管理する、ほのぼのとしたホラーゲームです。タピオカティーを作り、お客さんに提供し、メニューを広げていきましょう。
items.title: The Boba Teashop

items.description:
This game serves as a prequel chapter for the upcoming game 'Lake Haven'.
Detective Zeke Reynold is called to investigate what he assumes will be another case he'll quickly forget, but what he finds will be sewn into the fabric of his existence forever.
items.description_ja:
This game serves as a prequel chapter for the upcoming game 'Lake Haven'.
Detective Zeke Reynold is called to investigate what he assumes will be another case he'll quickly forget, but what he finds will be sewn into the fabric of his existence forever.
items.title: Lake Haven - Chrysalis

items.description: MOOD is a short visual novel combining horror, dark humor, and dialogues on a wide variety of topics, from old movies to ancient wars. You were the one who summoned your new companion, there is no backing out now!
items.description_ja: MOOD is a short visual novel combining horror, dark humor, and dialogues on a wide variety of topics, from old movies to ancient wars. You were the one who summoned your new companion, there is no backing out now!
items.title: MOOD

items.description: Minesweeper but the rules are changing, again.
items.description_ja: マインスイーパーですが、またもやルールが変わっています。
items.title: 14 Minesweeper Variants 2

items.description: Tower of Mask is a thrilling survival horror in the spirit of the 80's dungeon crawlers. The most claustrophobic dungeon in modern times is yours to venture through alone. Hero, face the ancient tower where eerie masked humans prowl.
items.description_ja: 『Tower of Mask』は80年代ダンジョンクローラーの精神を宿すスリリングなサバイバル・ホラーだ。現代において最も閉塞的なダンジョンを一人で存分に冒険できる。さぁ英雄よ、仮面人間が徘徊する古代の塔へ立ち向かえ！
items.title: Tower of Mask

items.description: Hungry Horrors is a story-driven deckbuilder set in the folklore of the British Isles. Cook real traditional dishes, chain flavour synergies, meet mythical characters, and feed legendary Horrors before they feed on you.
items.description_ja: 「ハングリー・ホラーズ」は、ブリテン諸島の民間伝承を舞台に、カードでデッキを組みながら物語を進めるゲームです。実在する伝統料理を作り、味の組み合わせで効果を高めながら冒険する中で、神話や伝説のキャラクターたちとの出会いが待っています。怪物たちに食べられてしまう前に、料理でそのお腹を満たすことが目標です。
items.title: Hungry Horrors

items.description: Occlude is a ritual disguised as Solitaire; a cosmic-horror card game where the rules are obscured and reality is at stake. Play through cryptic challenges to reveal forbidden lore in this singleplayer narrative puzzle game for the terminally curious. Don’t worry; you can always start over.
items.description_ja: OccludeはSolitaireに偽装された儀式です。ルールが隠され、現実が危機にさらされるコズミックホラーのカードゲームです。非常に好奇心旺盛なプレイヤーのためのシングルプレイヤー型ナラティブパズルゲームで、暗号のような課題を乗り越え、禁断の知識を解き明かしましょう。心配はいりません。いつでも最初からやり直せます。
items.title: Occlude

items.description: A bomb-throwing rabbit defends her floating fortress from her former friend turned foe.
items.description_ja: かつての友から空中要塞を守れ！　ボム投げウサギの爆裂爽快3Dジャンプアクション！
items.title: Bombun

items.description: A horror roguelike bento-builder. You're trapped in an underground kitchen, forced to feed a half-chef monster. Gamble with your life, assemble meals, and master your multipliers. Whatever you do, Don't Let it Starve.
items.description_ja: 恐怖のローグライク"ベントウ"ビルダー。地下室のキッチンに閉じ込められたあなたは、シェフのモンスターに料理を与え続けなければならない。自らの命を賭けて、食材を組み合わせて、乗数の与えてくれるうまみを生かそう。どんな手を使っても、"絶対に奴を空腹にするな"。
items.title: Don't Let It Starve

items.description: A psychological horror game about testing dolls and determining if they are Good or Dangerous. Play in a strange location with dolls potentially filled with bloodlust. Uncover secrets about who you are, where you are, and just WHAT is happening.

items.description:
From the creator of Angels of Death: the multi-ending exploration horror game The Forest of Drizzling Rain.
Includes Full Ver. (2022), completed nine years after the original release, and Original Ver. (2013), where it all began.
Alas, it was the "promised place," where Shiori was never meant to go.

『殺戮の天使』作者による、マルチEDの名作ホラーADV『霧雨が降る森』。

嗚呼、そこは――シオリが決して行ってはならない“約束の場所”だった。

items.title: Digger: Galactic Treasures

items.description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!
items.description_ja: ラヴクラフト風ホラーで愛を育もう！魅惑的な彗星ハレイがマンションの自室に墜落し、君は光と闇の惑星間戦争に巻き込まれてしまう。ホラーコメディービジュアルノベルでハレイに火を与え続けて世界を救え…そしてごほうびにキスをもらおう！

items.description: Erma's here and she has a.....science fair project to finish? Figure out how to find the remains of your project to get them back in time to finish for the science fair!

items.description_ja: 『カエルカード』はローグライクカードゲーム。キミは農場の管理者として、カエル会社のKPIを目指す。カードを引くことで時間爆発を回避・利用せよ！カードパックやサプライボックスを入手してデッキを構築し、カードを出すことでコインを稼ごう！そして作戦計画を立てて、選択イベント・凶年・大災厄に立ち向かえ！

items.description_ja: MoonMinersは、ディストピア的な未来を舞台にした、宇宙で働く鉱夫たちの協力型サバイバル・シミュレーターです。あなたは故郷から遠く離れた悪の企業のために働く宇宙鉱夫となり、仕事をするよりも死ぬ方がずっと簡単です。
items.title: MoonMiners

items.description: Wise Guys is a ruthless, high-stakes social deduction game where trust is a weapon and betrayal is just survival. Up to 12 players race against time to clean up their criminal operation and get out before the raid hits. Meanwhile, a Rat is quietly sabotaging the crew at every turn.
items.description_ja: Wise Guys is a ruthless, high-stakes social deduction game where trust is a weapon and betrayal is just survival. Up to 12 players race against time to clean up their criminal operation and get out before the raid hits. Meanwhile, a Rat is quietly sabotaging the crew at every turn.
items.title: WISE GUYS

items.description: There's been a murder aboard the Reuss Express, and you're the suspects! Prove your innocence in this comedy 'point n' click' murder mystery - packed with twists, laughs, and larger-than-life characters!
items.description_ja:
Reuss Expressで乗客が殺され、アナタが第一容疑者に！
スリリングな謎を解き明かし、アイテムベースのパズルを解いて、無実を証明しよう！
命がけのサプライズ、衝撃の急展開、そしてインパクト大なキャラクターたちが登場するドタバタアドベンチャー！
items.title: Loco Motive

items.description: "Seal: WHAT the FUN" is an omniverse multiplayer party royale game that allows up to 10 players to enjoy a range of compact plays in 10 minutes. Players can customize their characters with variety of effects and features, making the game more interactive and unpredictable.
items.description_ja: "Seal: WHAT the FUN" is an omniverse multiplayer party royale game that allows up to 10 players to enjoy a range of compact plays in 10 minutes. Players can customize their characters with variety of effects and features, making the game more interactive and unpredictable.
items.title: Seal: WHAT the FUN

items.description: Defend humanity's last surviving metropolis from mysterious alien machinations in this challenging base-defense arcade shooter. Featuring rapid upgrade progression, procedurally generated attack waves, dark humor and laser-sharp aesthetics.
items.description_ja: Defend humanity's last surviving metropolis from mysterious alien machinations in this challenging base-defense arcade shooter. Featuring rapid upgrade progression, procedurally generated attack waves, dark humor and laser-sharp aesthetics.
items.title: Utopia Must Fall

items.description: Take on the hard yet fair world of Bloody Trapland. Jump, slide, dash and dodge your way through the many deadly levels. Find secrets, solve puzzles, unlock mysteries and unravel the story. Go at it alone or bring your friends along for a co-op experience like no other. 1-4 players online and/or splitscreen.
items.description_ja:
「ブラッディ・トラプランド」 の過酷ながらも公正な世界に立ち向かえ。
危険なレベルで飛び越えたり、滑ったり、ダッシュしたり、避けたりしましょう。
秘密を見つけ、パズルを解き、謎を解き明かし、物語を進む。
1~4人のプレーヤーがオンラインまたはスプリットスクリーンでプレイできます。
items.title: Bloody Trapland 2: Curiosity

items.description: A unique platforming experience where the protagonist, story, and mechanics are constantly changing. Take control of legendary warriors, giant worms, greedy kings, and lazy demons, each with their own purpose.
items.description_ja: 『俺が勇者！？』は、ひと味違うアクションアドベンチャーゲームです。プレイの中で物語の視点やゲーム体験、さらには操作するキャラクターまでもが次々と変化していきます。複数の視点が交差する中で、あなたはこの物語の真実にたどり着けるでしょうか？
items.title: The Warrior

items.description: Lead the world to apocalyse with lemonades! Price affects demand, but take into account the cost of each lemonade when selling. Upgrades reduce cost and increase demand. Invest in a factory, and eventually control the politics of the world to increase climate's temperature and beverage consumption.
items.description_ja: Lead the world to apocalyse with lemonades! Price affects demand, but take into account the cost of each lemonade when selling. Upgrades reduce cost and increase demand. Invest in a factory, and eventually control the politics of the world to increase climate's temperature and beverage consumption.
items.title: Lemonade Apocalypse: First Squeeze

items.description: Pilfer from pirates, conspire with cardinals and perform miracles with an incompetent magician. The Procession to Calvary is a Pythonesque adventure game made from Renaissance paintings, and a spiritual successor to the critically acclaimed Four Last Things.
items.description_ja: 海賊の持ち物をくすね、枢機卿たちと結託し、無能な手品師とともに奇跡を起こそう。『The Procession to Calvary』は、ルネサンス期の絵画で作られたシュールな冒険ゲームにして、評判作『Four Last Things』の精神を受け継ぐ作品。
items.title: The Procession to Calvary

items.description: A metrics-obsessed AI will monitor, profile, and entertain you as you progress through over a hundred genre-bending puzzles in this delightfully satirical adventure.
items.description_ja: この痛快な風刺的アドベンチャーでは、プレイヤーがジャンルを超える100以上のパズルを解き進める中で、データに取り憑かれたAIがプレイヤーの監視とプロファイリングをして楽しませます。
items.title: Lab Rat

items.description: Topple Tactics is a physics-based multiplayer tower defense game where one huge player controls the map by placing towers and using abilities, whilst the little players level up their stats and equipment to reach the end of the map and defeat the huge player!
items.description_ja: Topple Tactics is a physics-based multiplayer tower defense game where one huge player controls the map by placing towers and using abilities, whilst the little players level up their stats and equipment to reach the end of the map and defeat the huge player!
items.title: Topple Tactics

items.description: Ducks like to race, even in their own cars! Earn money by delivering food to fellow ducks in the city, then use this money to upgrade your vehicle. The better the vehicle, the better chance you have to win the race at the end of the day!
items.description_ja: Ducks like to race, even in their own cars! Earn money by delivering food to fellow ducks in the city, then use this money to upgrade your vehicle. The better the vehicle, the better chance you have to win the race at the end of the day!
items.title: Ducks Can Drive

items.description: A relaxing and humorous idle god simulator that stays at the bottom of your screen or on a second monitor while you do other things. With physics-based dragging interactions, it feels just like playing with desk toys.
items.description_ja: **『だらだら村』**は、デスクトップで遊べる放置ゲーム。仕事中にこっそりサボるための最強ツールです！神様になって、モンスターを召喚し、勇者を育てて、建物をアップグレード。仕事しているフリをしながら、こっそり遊べます。物理演算でのドラッグ操作は、デスクの上の小さなおもちゃで遊ぶ感覚そのもの！サボりたいなら、これで決まり！
items.title: Loafing Town

items.description: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.
items.description_ja: 「マシン・パーティー」は、失敗が死に直結する、危険なパーティーゲーム集です。仲間を集め、命懸けの極限状況に挑み、自分だけが生き残る価値を示しましょう。生還は望めない。
items.title: Machine Party

items.description: You are a lone Ukrainian military drone operator battling Russian occupation forces. Hidden deep behind enemy lines, you operate your drone to seek and destroy tanks and armored vehicles, shatter communication lines, and recover stolen goods. Slava Ukraini!
items.description_ja: "Death From Above"で、ウクライナ軍のドローンオペレーターとして敵陣の背後に回り込もう。多才なドローンを操縦し、エリア内の侵略者の排除や地雷原の撤去、補給部隊の迎撃を行い、イースターエッグが大量に隠されたサンドボックス満載のマップを探索しよう。より良い明日のために戦おう！ウクライナに栄光あれ！
items.title: Death From Above: A Ukrainian Drone Warstory

items.description: Team up with up to 8 friends online to explore the haunted, randomly generated depths of these dusty attics. Find and repair the objectives, flip the master switch and escape before the ghastly ghoul that lurks in the darkness catches up to you. Play through the career mode or explore free play!

items.description:
Dodge bullets to the rhythm and take down everything that moves!
A rhythmical danmaku action game.
items.description_ja:
音楽のリズムに合わせて弾をかわし、動くものを全てしばき倒せ！
リズミカルな弾幕アクションゲーム。
items.title: Yoiyami Dancers: Twilight Danmaku Dancers

items.description: "Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines" - In this short story from the Endless Monday, Penny, a mild-mannered corporate grunt, spends a weekend at the office in an effort to finish her project on time while overcoming distractions from coworkers, space aliens, imaginary friends, and herself.
items.description_ja: 「Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines」はEndless Mondayから派生した短編です。温厚な会社員のペニーがオフィスで週末を過ごし、同僚や宇宙人、イマジナリーフレンド、さらには自分自身からの妨害を乗り越えて、仕事を締め切りに間に合わせようと奮闘します。
items.title: Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines

items.description: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!
items.description_ja: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!
items.title: We Steal From Old People: The Game

items.description: Regular Human Workshop is a 2D physics simulation sandbox. There are no predefined goals or objectives. Simply throw objects into the world and interact with them in various ways.
items.description_ja: Regular Human Workshop is a 2D physics simulation sandbox. There are no predefined goals or objectives. Simply throw objects into the world and interact with them in various ways.
items.title: Regular Human Workshop

items.description: Experience a sneak peek of YIIK I.V! Step beyond Alex Eggleston's story and become the Nameless Child, a young girl pushed from a mysterious tower. Guide her through a surreal dimension where she must find a way to save both the Good Brother and the Bad Brother.
items.description_ja:
「YIIK: A Postmodern RPG」を大胆に再解釈し、発展させた「YIIK I.V」を体感しよう！
物語はアレックス＝エグルストンを離れ、謎の塔から突き落とされた少女「名もなき子」へ。
この世のものとは思えない世界を彷徨う少女を導き、「良いお兄ちゃん」と「悪いお兄ちゃん」の2人を救う方法を見つけなければならない。
items.title: YIIK Nameless Psychosis

items.description: Become a tiny ZX8000 robot and begin your journey through a beautiful, pixel-art world inspired by games iconic to the platformer genre. Follow a cute story, upgrade your skills, beat challenging levels, and compete with other players for the fastest speedrun!
items.description_ja: 小さなロボット「ZX8000」を操作し、数々のプラットフォーム系ゲームの名作にインスパイアされた、美しいドット絵の世界へ旅立とう。お茶目なストーリーを進めてスキルを磨き、激ムズステージのクリアタイムをほかのプレイヤーと競え!
items.title: BZZZT

items.description: In this physics-based co-op platformer, you and a friend must carry your short-tempered king through deadly medieval courses. Dodge traps, maintain balance, and work together to reach the throne room. One wrong step, and the king might crown you with his rage!
items.description_ja: 王様が谷間に落ちた！ここから2人で王を担ぐ“搬送”アドベンチャーが始まる！息を合わせて担架を操作し、王様を落とさず王座まで運び切れ。道中は危険だらけ。バランスを崩せばすぐ転ぶ。失敗は派手で笑える。成功は努力と実力への褒美。親友を誘って二人きりの抱腹絶倒の時間を過ごそう。
items.title: Hold Your King

items.description: The local Adventurer's Guild is hiring!... Not for adventurers, but for guild clerks! You play an important role in handing out quests, gold, and equipment as your actions shape the stories of these animal adventurers for better, or for worse..!
items.description_ja: The local Adventurer's Guild is hiring!... Not for adventurers, but for guild clerks! You play an important role in handing out quests, gold, and equipment as your actions shape the stories of these animal adventurers for better, or for worse..!
